examples.en: The nucleus of a plant cell contains most of its genetic material.
examples.zh: 植物細胞的細胞核含有大部分的遺傳物質。

examples.en: In most atoms, the nucleus contains both protons and neutrons.
examples.zh: 在大多數原子中，原子核同時含有質子與中子。

examples.en: These five students form the nucleus of our debate team.
examples.zh: 這五位學生是我們辯論隊的核心。

examples.en: The museum has a famous painting of a nude figure.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一幅著名的裸體人像畫。

examples.en: She chose a nude lipstick for the job interview.
examples.zh: 她選了裸色口紅去參加面試。

examples.en: The artist drew a nude model in class.
examples.zh: 藝術家在課堂上畫了一位裸體模特兒。

examples.en: Parents can nurture their children's curiosity by answering questions patiently.
examples.zh: 父母可以透過耐心回答問題，培養孩子的好奇心。

examples.en: She likes to nurture young plants on her balcony.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在陽台上培育幼苗。

examples.en: Good teachers nurture talent in every student.
examples.zh: 好老師會在每位學生身上培養才能。

examples.en: Care and nurture are important for a child's growth.
examples.zh: 關愛與養育對孩子的成長很重要。

examples.en: Some people think nurture matters more than nature.
examples.zh: 有些人認為後天養育比先天天性更重要。

examples.en: The teacher's nurture helped the shy boy gain confidence.
examples.zh: 老師的栽培讓這個害羞的男孩有了自信。

examples.en: The travelers rested at an oasis in the desert.
examples.zh: 旅人們在沙漠中的一處綠洲休息。

examples.en: Camels drank water at the oasis before continuing across the desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝在綠洲喝水後，繼續穿越沙漠。

examples.en: This quiet café is an oasis in the busy city.
examples.zh: 這間安靜的咖啡廳是繁忙城市裡的一方綠洲。

examples.en: The new mayor took an oath of office yesterday.
examples.zh: 新市長昨天宣誓就職。

examples.en: He made an oath to always tell the truth.
examples.zh: 他立誓永遠說實話。

examples.en: Doctors take an oath to help their patients.
examples.zh: 醫師宣誓要幫助他們的病人。

examples.en: I usually eat oatmeal with milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐通常吃加牛奶的燕麥粥。

examples.en: Oatmeal contains fiber that can help support a healthy heart.
examples.zh: 燕麥片含有有助於維持心臟健康的纖維。

examples.en: She added some fruit to her bowl of oatmeal.
examples.zh: 她在那碗燕麥粥裡加了一些水果。

examples.en: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
examples.zh: 法律規定駕駛人必須繫安全帶。

examples.en: I would be obliged if you could close the window.
examples.zh: 如果你能關上窗戶，我會很感激。

examples.en: The librarian was happy to oblige when I asked for help.
examples.zh: 我請求協助時，圖書館員很樂意幫忙。

senses.zh: 使著迷；使心神不寧；過度掛心

examples.en: Don't let one small mistake obsess you.
examples.zh: 別讓一個小錯誤一直困擾著你。

examples.en: He is obsessed with collecting model cars.
examples.zh: 他沉迷於收集模型車。

examples.en: She obsesses over every grade on her report card.
examples.zh: 她過度在意成績單上的每個分數。

examples.en: My grandfather is too obstinate to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 我爺爺太固執，不肯去看醫生。

examples.en: The obstinate child refused to eat any vegetables.
examples.zh: 那個固執的孩子拒絕吃任何蔬菜。

examples.en: An obstinate stain stayed on the shirt after washing.
examples.zh: 洗過之後，襯衫上仍留著一塊頑固的污漬。

examples.en: Earthquakes are a common occurrence in this area.
examples.zh: 地震在這個地區是常見的事。

examples.en: The report shows the occurrence of flu cases each month.
examples.zh: 這份報告顯示每個月流感病例的發生情況。

examples.en: Delays are a regular occurrence on this bus line.
examples.zh: 這條公車路線經常誤點。

examples.en: An octopus uses its eight arms to explore its surroundings.
examples.zh: 章魚用八條腕探索周圍的環境。

examples.en: We watched an octopus swim at the aquarium.
examples.zh: 我們在水族館看章魚游泳。

examples.en: She ordered grilled octopus at the seafood restaurant.
examples.zh: 她在海鮮餐廳點了烤章魚。

examples.en: A strange odor came from the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡飄出一股奇怪的味道。

examples.en: This spray removes odor from shoes without leaving a strong scent.
examples.zh: 這種噴霧能去除鞋子的異味，不會留下強烈的香氣。

examples.en: The odor of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味充滿了廚房。

examples.en: The company built an offshore wind farm.
examples.zh: 這家公司建了一座離岸風力發電場。

examples.en: Offshore fishing is popular in this town.
examples.zh: 近海捕魚在這個小鎮很盛行。

examples.en: He keeps an offshore bank account in another country.
examples.zh: 他在另一個國家有一個境外銀行帳戶。

senses.zh: 在離岸處；在海外；向海面

examples.en: The boat anchored offshore for the night.
examples.zh: 船在離岸處停泊過夜。

examples.en: Many factories moved offshore to cut costs.
examples.zh: 許多工廠為了降低成本而遷往海外。

examples.en: A strong wind was blowing offshore as we walked along the beach.
examples.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步時，一陣強風正從陸地吹向海面。

examples.en: Birds feed their offspring several times a day.
examples.zh: 鳥類一天會餵養牠們的幼鳥好幾次。

examples.en: The couple's offspring all became teachers after graduating from the same university.
examples.zh: 這對夫婦的子女從同一所大學畢業後，都成為老師。

examples.en: Pandas usually have one offspring at a time.
examples.zh: 熊貓通常一次只生一隻幼獸。

senses.zh: 生效的；運作中的；關鍵的

examples.en: The new rules will be operative from next Monday.
examples.zh: 新規定將從下週一起生效。

examples.en: The elevator is not operative at the moment.
examples.zh: 電梯目前無法運作。

examples.en: The operative word in that rule is "must".
examples.zh: 那條規定中最關鍵的字是「必須」。

examples.en: The factory hired ten skilled operatives last month.
examples.zh: 工廠上個月僱用了十名技術工人。

examples.en: An operative from the agency followed the suspect.
examples.zh: 該機構的一名情報員跟蹤了嫌疑人。

examples.en: Each operative must wear a safety helmet.
examples.zh: 每位操作人員都必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: The king oppressed the poor with heavy taxes.
examples.zh: 國王用重稅壓迫窮人。

examples.en: No one should oppress others because of their race.
examples.zh: 任何人都不該因種族而壓迫他人。

examples.en: Many people felt oppressed under the old government.
examples.zh: 許多人在舊政府統治下感到受壓迫。

examples.en: The people fought against oppression for many years.
examples.zh: 人民為反抗壓迫奮鬥了許多年。

examples.en: Women in that country suffered oppression for centuries.
examples.zh: 那個國家的女性受壓迫長達好幾世紀。

examples.en: A feeling of oppression filled the small room.
examples.zh: 一股壓抑的感覺籠罩著那間小房間。

examples.en: Waiting for the test results was a real ordeal.
examples.zh: 等待檢查結果真是一場煎熬。

examples.en: The hikers survived their ordeal in the snow.
examples.zh: 登山客熬過了雪中的艱難考驗。

examples.en: Speaking in front of a crowd is an ordeal for him.
examples.zh: 在眾人面前說話對他來說是一種折磨。

examples.en: The organizer of the concert thanked everyone for coming.
examples.zh: 音樂會的主辦人感謝大家的到來。

examples.en: She is the organizer of our school trip.
examples.zh: 她是我們校外旅行的籌劃者。

examples.en: I bought a desk organizer for my pens and notes.
examples.zh: 我買了一個桌上收納盒來放筆和便條紙。

senses.zh: 使熟悉環境；使對準方位；針對

examples.en: The guide helped new students orient themselves on campus.
examples.zh: 導覽人員協助新生熟悉校園環境。

examples.en: Use a compass to orient the map correctly.
examples.zh: 用指南針把地圖的方位對準。

examples.en: The training program is oriented toward beginners.
examples.zh: 這個培訓課程是以初學者為對象。

examples.en: The museum has a large collection of oriental art.
examples.zh: 這間博物館收藏了大量東方藝術品。

examples.en: She bought an oriental carpet for the living room.
examples.zh: 她為客廳買了一條東方風格的地毯。

examples.en: He is studying oriental medicine at the university.
examples.zh: 他在大學裡研讀東方醫學。

examples.en: Many fairy tales originate from old folk stories.
examples.zh: 許多童話故事源自古老的民間傳說。

examples.en: The fire originated in the kitchen and spread to the hallway.
examples.zh: 火災從廚房開始，並延燒到走廊。

examples.en: Tea is believed to have originated in China.
examples.zh: 一般認為茶起源於中國。

examples.en: We hung a glass ornament on the Christmas tree.
examples.zh: 我們在聖誕樹上掛了一個玻璃裝飾品。

examples.en: A small ornament sat on the shelf by the window.
examples.zh: 窗邊的架子上放著一個小擺飾。

examples.en: The old church is full of beautiful gold ornaments.
examples.zh: 那座古老的教堂裡滿是美麗的金色裝飾。

examples.en: They ornamented the hall with flowers and lights.
examples.zh: 他們用花和燈裝飾大廳。

examples.en: The cake was ornamented with fresh strawberries.
examples.zh: 蛋糕上點綴著新鮮草莓。

examples.en: She ornamented her notebook with colorful stickers.
examples.zh: 她用彩色貼紙裝飾她的筆記本。

examples.en: He follows an orthodox way of teaching math.
examples.zh: 他用傳統的方式教數學。

examples.en: The doctor suggested an orthodox treatment first.
examples.zh: 醫師建議先採用正統的治療方式。

examples.en: Some students found the orthodox method too slow.
examples.zh: 有些學生覺得這種傳統方法太慢了。

examples.en: An outbreak of flu closed the school for a week.
examples.zh: 流感爆發使學校停課一週。

examples.en: The city acted quickly to stop the outbreak.
examples.zh: 這個城市迅速採取行動遏止疫情爆發。

examples.en: The outbreak of the war changed many lives.
examples.zh: 戰爭的爆發改變了許多人的生活。

examples.en: My sister is outgoing and makes friends easily.
examples.zh: 我姊姊個性外向，很容易交到朋友。

examples.en: The outgoing manager gave a short speech.
examples.zh: 離任的經理發表了簡短的談話。

examples.en: Please put the outgoing mail in the basket.
examples.zh: 請把要寄出的郵件放進籃子裡。

examples.en: Our class went on an outing to the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們班到動物園出遊。

examples.en: A family outing to the beach sounds great.
examples.zh: 全家一起去海邊玩聽起來很棒。

examples.en: The company planned a weekend outing for its staff.
examples.zh: 公司為員工安排了週末的出遊活動。

examples.en: The government plans to outlaw smoking in parks.
examples.zh: 政府打算立法禁止在公園吸菸。

examples.en: Many countries have outlawed single-use plastic bags to reduce ocean pollution.
examples.zh: 許多國家為了減少海洋污染，已明令禁止一次用塑膠袋。

examples.en: The school outlawed phones during exams to prevent students from cheating.
examples.zh: 學校禁止在考試期間使用手機，以防止學生作弊。

examples.en: The movie is about an outlaw in the Old West.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是西部拓荒時代的一名亡命之徒。

examples.en: The villagers were afraid of the outlaw.
examples.zh: 村民們很害怕那個亡命之徒。

examples.en: The sheriff chased the outlaw across the desert.
examples.zh: 警長追著那個亡命之徒穿越沙漠。

examples.en: The economic outlook for next year looks good.
examples.zh: 明年的經濟前景看好。

examples.en: She has a positive outlook on life.
examples.zh: 她對人生抱持樂觀的看法。

examples.en: The weather outlook for the weekend is sunny.
examples.zh: 週末的天氣預測是晴天。

examples.en: Girls outnumber boys in our class by two to one.
examples.zh: 我們班女生人數是男生的兩倍。

examples.en: Cars outnumber bicycles on this street, especially during the morning rush.
examples.zh: 這條街上汽車比腳踏車多，尤其在早晨的尖峰時段。

examples.en: Visitors outnumbered the staff at the museum.
examples.zh: 博物館裡的訪客比工作人員還多。

examples.en: The new rule banning pets from parks caused public outrage.
examples.zh: 這項禁止寵物進入公園的新規定引起公憤。

examples.en: People expressed outrage at the high prices.
examples.zh: 人們對高昂的價格表達憤怒。

examples.en: Closing the town's only public library would be an outrage.
examples.zh: 關閉鎮上唯一的公共圖書館將是一件令人憤慨的事。

examples.en: The referee's unfair decision outraged many fans watching the final match.
examples.zh: 裁判不公平的判決使許多正在觀看決賽的球迷感到憤慨。

examples.en: It outraged her that nobody helped the injured man outside the station.
examples.zh: 沒有人幫助車站外那名受傷的男子，這讓她感到憤慨。

examples.en: The news outraged people across the country.
examples.zh: 這則消息使全國民眾都感到憤怒。

examples.en: The price of this bag is outrageous.
examples.zh: 這個包包的價格太離譜了。

examples.en: He told an outrageous story about meeting a movie star.
examples.zh: 他講了一個說自己遇到電影明星的荒唐故事。

examples.en: It is outrageous that the train is late again.
examples.zh: 火車又誤點，真是令人氣憤。

examples.en: The team won an outright victory in the final.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中取得了完勝。

examples.en: What he said was an outright lie.
examples.zh: 他說的完全是謊話。

examples.en: She made an outright refusal to join the club.
examples.zh: 她直截了當地拒絕加入社團。

senses.zh: 直截了當地；當場；一次付清地

examples.en: He told me outright that he did not like the plan.
examples.zh: 他直截了當地告訴我，他不喜歡這個計畫。

examples.en: They bought the house outright with cash.
examples.zh: 他們用現金一次付清買下了那棟房子。

examples.en: The company offered her the job outright at the end of the interview.
examples.zh: 面試結束時，公司當場就給了她這份工作。

examples.en: I told him my plan at the outset.
examples.zh: 一開始我就把我的計畫告訴他了。

examples.en: There were problems from the outset of the project.
examples.zh: 這個專案從一開始就出現問題。

examples.en: The teacher explained the rules at the outset of class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂一開始就說明了規則。

examples.en: They live on the outskirts of Taipei.
examples.zh: 他們住在台北的市郊。

examples.en: A new shopping mall opened on the outskirts of town.
examples.zh: 鎮上的郊區新開了一間購物中心。

examples.en: The bus runs from downtown to the outskirts.
examples.zh: 這班公車從市中心開往郊區。

examples.en: Don't overdo it on your first day at the gym.
examples.zh: 第一天上健身房不要做得太過頭。

examples.en: She overdid the salt, so the soup was too salty.
examples.zh: 她鹽放太多，所以湯太鹹了。

examples.en: It is easy to overdo the makeup for a party.
examples.zh: 為了參加派對，很容易把妝化得太濃。

examples.en: I overheard two students talking about the exam.
examples.zh: 我無意中聽到兩個學生在談論考試。

examples.en: She overheard her parents planning a surprise party.
examples.zh: 她無意間聽到爸媽正在籌劃驚喜派對。

examples.en: We were overheard by the people at the next table.
examples.zh: 我們說的話被隔壁桌的人聽見了。

examples.en: The two classes overlap on Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 這兩堂課在週二下午時間重疊。

examples.en: Our work hours overlap for about two hours.
examples.zh: 我們的工作時間大約有兩小時重疊。

examples.en: Draw two circles that overlap each other.
examples.zh: 畫兩個互相重疊的圓。

examples.en: There is a big overlap between the two courses.
examples.zh: 這兩門課有很大一部分內容重複。

examples.en: The overlap of the two shapes is colored red.
examples.zh: 兩個圖形重疊的部分被塗成紅色。

examples.en: We found some overlap in our schedules.
examples.zh: 我們發現行程有一些重疊的地方。

examples.en: Don't overwork yourself before the exam; take regular breaks while studying.
examples.zh: 考試前別讓自己過度勞累；讀書時要定時休息。

examples.en: The company overworks its staff during the holidays.
examples.zh: 這家公司在假期期間讓員工過度工作。

examples.en: He got sick because he overworked for months.
examples.zh: 他因為連續幾個月過度工作而生病了。

examples.en: Overwork can cause serious health problems and reduce concentration at work.
examples.zh: 過勞可能造成嚴重的健康問題，並降低工作時的專注力。

examples.en: The doctor said his headaches came from overwork.
examples.zh: 醫師說他的頭痛是過勞引起的。

examples.en: Many office workers suffer from overwork during the busy tax season.
examples.zh: 許多上班族在報稅旺季飽受過勞之苦。

examples.en: My uncle farms oysters near the coast.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在海邊養殖牡蠣。

examples.en: We ate fried oyster omelets at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市吃了蚵仔煎。

examples.en: Some oysters can make pearls inside their shells.
examples.zh: 有些牡蠣能在殼裡孕育出珍珠。

examples.en: The ozone layer protects us by absorbing much of the sun's ultraviolet radiation.
examples.zh: 臭氧層吸收大量太陽紫外線，藉此保護我們。

examples.en: Scientists are watching the hole in the ozone layer.
examples.zh: 科學家持續關注臭氧層的破洞。

examples.en: High ozone levels can make it hard to breathe.
examples.zh: 臭氧濃度過高可能讓人呼吸困難。

examples.en: He lost his paddle and could not steer the boat.
examples.zh: 他把槳弄丟了，沒辦法操控小船。

examples.en: The boy hit the ball with a table tennis paddle.
examples.zh: 那個男孩用桌球拍打球。

examples.en: Each person in the canoe needs a paddle.
examples.zh: 獨木舟上的每個人都需要一支槳。

examples.en: We paddled slowly across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們緩緩划過寧靜的湖面。

examples.en: The children paddled in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 孩子們在淺水裡玩水。

examples.en: They paddled the canoe down the river.
examples.zh: 他們划著獨木舟順流而下。

examples.en: I bought a paperback at the airport.
examples.zh: 我在機場買了一本平裝書。

examples.en: A paperback is cheaper than a hardcover.
examples.zh: 平裝書比精裝書便宜。

examples.en: She always carries a paperback in her bag.
examples.zh: 她包包裡總是帶著一本平裝書。

examples.en: The paperback edition comes out next month.
examples.zh: 平裝版下個月出版。

examples.en: He prefers paperback novels because they are light.
examples.zh: 他偏好平裝小說，因為比較輕。

examples.en: This paperback dictionary is easy to carry.
examples.zh: 這本平裝字典很方便攜帶。

examples.en: It is a paradox that the richest city has so many poor people.
examples.zh: 最富裕的城市卻有這麼多窮人，真是矛盾。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a famous paradox to think about.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一個著名的悖論來思考。

examples.en: There is a paradox in saying that less is more.
examples.zh: 「少即是多」這句話本身就有矛盾之處。

examples.en: The accident paralyzed his left leg, so he now uses crutches to walk.
examples.zh: 那場意外使他的左腿癱瘓，所以他現在拄拐杖走路。

examples.en: A heavy snowstorm paralyzed the city's traffic.
examples.zh: 一場大暴雪使整座城市的交通陷入癱瘓。

examples.en: Fear paralyzed her and she could not speak.
examples.zh: 恐懼讓她僵住了，說不出話來。

examples.en: Reading is my favorite pastime on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天，閱讀是我最愛的消遣。

examples.en: Fishing is a popular pastime in this town.
examples.zh: 釣魚是這個小鎮很受歡迎的休閒活動。

examples.en: My grandfather's favorite pastime is growing roses in his backyard.
examples.zh: 我爺爺最愛的消遣是在後院種玫瑰。

examples.en: He is a true patriot who loves his country.
examples.zh: 他是一位真正熱愛國家的愛國者。

examples.en: The museum tells the story of a famous patriot.
examples.zh: 這間博物館講述一位著名愛國者的故事。

examples.en: Many patriots joined the parade on National Day.
examples.zh: 許多愛國人士在國慶日參加了遊行。

examples.en: The peacock opened its colorful tail for the visitors.
examples.zh: 孔雀向遊客展開了牠色彩繽紛的尾羽。

examples.en: We saw a peacock walking around the garden.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻孔雀在花園裡閒逛。

examples.en: A peacock sheds its long tail feathers after the breeding season.
examples.zh: 繁殖季結束後，雄孔雀的長尾羽會脫落。

examples.en: Don't peek at your presents before your birthday.
examples.zh: 生日之前不要偷看你的禮物。

examples.en: The little girl peeked through the keyhole.
examples.zh: 小女孩從鑰匙孔偷看。

examples.en: He peeked at the answer sheet during the quiz.
examples.zh: 他在小考時偷瞄了答案卷。

examples.en: Take a peek at the cake in the oven.
examples.zh: 去看一眼烤箱裡的蛋糕。

examples.en: I took a quick peek at the menu before sitting down.
examples.zh: 我坐下之前先快速瞄了一眼菜單。

examples.en: The trailer gives fans a peek at the new movie.
examples.zh: 這支預告片讓影迷先一睹新電影的風貌。

examples.en: My visa application is still pending, so I cannot book my flight.
examples.zh: 我的簽證申請仍在處理中，所以我還不能訂機票。

examples.en: There are three pending orders on the list.
examples.zh: 清單上有三筆尚未處理的訂單。

examples.en: The court will make a decision on the pending case soon.
examples.zh: 法院即將對這件懸而未決的案子作出裁決。

examples.en: The meeting was delayed pending the manager's arrival.
examples.zh: 會議因等待經理到場而延後。

examples.en: The driver was allowed to leave pending further checks.
examples.zh: 在進一步檢查之前，駕駛獲准先行離開。

examples.en: The shop is closed pending repairs to its damaged roof.
examples.zh: 這家店在受損屋頂修復完成前暫停營業。

examples.en: Italy is a long peninsula that extends into the Mediterranean Sea.
examples.zh: 義大利是一個伸入地中海的狹長半島。

examples.en: We rented a small cabin on the peninsula for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我們在半島上租了一間小木屋度週末。

examples.en: This peninsula is famous for its beautiful beaches and fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 這個半島以美麗的海灘和新鮮的海鮮聞名。

senses.zh: 棲息；坐在邊緣；坐落高處

examples.en: A small bird perched on the branch outside my window.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥棲息在我窗外的樹枝上。

examples.en: She perched on the edge of the desk and began to talk.
examples.zh: 她坐在書桌邊緣開始說話。

examples.en: The old house perches on a hill above the village.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子坐落在村莊上方的山丘上。

examples.en: The parrot jumped from its perch to my shoulder.
examples.zh: 鸚鵡從棲木跳到我的肩膀上。

examples.en: From his perch on the ladder, he could see the whole yard.
examples.zh: 從他在梯子上的位置，他可以看見整個院子。

examples.en: We cooked the perch we caught in the lake for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們把在湖裡釣到的鱸魚煮來當晚餐。

examples.en: The sailors were in great peril when the storm hit.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來襲時，水手們身陷極大的危險。

examples.en: The rescue team saved the hikers from peril.
examples.zh: 救援隊把登山客從險境中救了出來。

examples.en: Parents must teach children about the perils of crossing busy roads.
examples.zh: 家長必須教孩子了解穿越繁忙道路的危險。

examples.en: Many plants will perish if the weather stays this cold.
examples.zh: 如果天氣持續這麼冷，許多植物會死亡。

examples.en: The ancient city perished after a terrible earthquake.
examples.zh: 這座古城在一場可怕的地震後毀滅了。

examples.en: Fresh fruit will perish quickly if you leave it in the sun.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果如果放在太陽下，很快就會腐壞。

examples.en: Cell phones are permissible in the hallway but not in class.
examples.zh: 走廊上可以使用手機，但課堂上不行。

examples.en: Is it permissible to bring my own food into the theater?
examples.zh: 可以自己帶食物進電影院嗎？

examples.en: The maximum permissible speed on this road is 50 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 這條路的最高容許車速是每小時五十公里。

examples.en: If you persevere, you will eventually learn to play the piano.
examples.zh: 只要你堅持不懈，最後一定能學會彈鋼琴。

examples.en: She persevered despite many failures and finally won the contest.
examples.zh: 儘管多次失敗，她仍堅持下去，最後贏得了比賽。

examples.en: We must persevere with our study plan even when it gets difficult.
examples.zh: 即使變得困難，我們也必須持續努力執行讀書計畫。

examples.en: Her persistence paid off when she passed the exam.
examples.zh: 她的毅力有了回報，她通過了考試。

examples.en: Learning a language takes time and persistence.
examples.zh: 學習語言需要時間和堅持。

examples.en: The persistence of the noise made it hard to sleep.
examples.zh: 噪音一直持續，讓人很難入睡。

examples.en: She is a persistent student who never gives up.
examples.zh: 她是個堅持不懈、從不放棄的學生。

examples.en: Persistent rain has delayed the opening of the new park.
examples.zh: 連日不停的雨延後了新公園的開幕。

examples.en: The company received persistent complaints about the slow service.
examples.zh: 公司不斷收到對緩慢服務的抱怨。

examples.en: Petroleum is used to make gasoline and plastic.
examples.zh: 石油可用來製造汽油和塑膠。

examples.en: The country earns most of its money from exporting petroleum.
examples.zh: 這個國家的收入大多來自出口石油。

examples.en: Prices of petroleum products rose again this month.
examples.zh: 本月石油製品的價格又上漲了。

examples.en: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
examples.zh: 藥師解釋了這種藥該怎麼服用。

examples.en: My aunt works as a pharmacist at a hospital in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在台北一家醫院擔任藥師。

examples.en: Ask the pharmacist if the two medicines are safe to take together.
examples.zh: 請問藥師這兩種藥可不可以一起吃。

examples.en: There is a pharmacy next to the supermarket.
examples.zh: 超市旁邊有一間藥局。

examples.en: I picked up my medicine at the pharmacy after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我到藥局領藥。

examples.en: He is studying pharmacy at a university in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 他在高雄一所大學主修藥學。

examples.en: A pickpocket stole her wallet on the crowded train.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的火車上，扒手偷走了她的皮夾。

examples.en: Watch out for pickpockets when you visit busy tourist areas.
examples.zh: 到熱鬧的觀光區時要小心扒手。

examples.en: The police caught the pickpocket near the night market.
examples.zh: 警方在夜市附近抓到了那名扒手。

examples.en: I woke up with a big pimple on my nose.
examples.zh: 我一覺醒來，鼻子上長了一顆大痘痘。

examples.en: Don't squeeze your pimples, or they may leave marks.
examples.zh: 不要擠痘痘，不然可能會留下痘疤。

examples.en: Teenagers often get a pimple or two before big events.
examples.zh: 青少年常在重要場合前冒出一兩顆痘痘。

examples.en: She pinched my arm to wake me up.
examples.zh: 她捏了我的手臂把我叫醒。

examples.en: These shoes pinch my toes when I walk fast.
examples.zh: 我走快的時候，這雙鞋會夾痛我的腳趾。

examples.en: He pinched his nose because of the bad smell.
examples.zh: 他因為難聞的氣味而捏住鼻子。

examples.en: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一小撮鹽。

examples.en: She gave the dough a gentle pinch to seal the edges.
examples.zh: 她輕輕捏了麵糰一下，把邊緣封好。

examples.en: In a pinch, you can use milk instead of cream.
examples.zh: 緊要關頭時，你可以用牛奶代替鮮奶油。

examples.en: The city lost thousands of people to the plague in the 1300s.
examples.zh: 這座城市在十四世紀因鼠疫失去了數千人。

examples.en: A plague of insects ruined the farmers' crops.
examples.zh: 大量害蟲毀了農民的作物。

examples.en: Historians study how the plague spread across Europe.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究鼠疫如何傳遍歐洲。

examples.en: Back pain has plagued him for years.
examples.zh: 背痛困擾了他好幾年。

examples.en: Delays and technical problems plagued the project.
examples.zh: 延誤和技術問題一直困擾著這項專案。

examples.en: Mosquitoes plague the campsite every summer despite efforts to control them.
examples.zh: 儘管已採取防治措施，蚊子每年夏天仍困擾著這個露營區。

examples.en: My grandfather worked on a tea plantation in Nantou.
examples.zh: 我祖父曾在南投的一座茶葉種植園工作。

examples.en: The banana plantation covers hundreds of hectares.
examples.zh: 這座香蕉種植園占地數百公頃。

examples.en: Workers on the coffee plantation pick the beans by hand.
examples.zh: 咖啡種植園的工人用手採收咖啡豆。

examples.en: Shakespeare is the most famous playwright in English history.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞是英國歷史上最有名的劇作家。

examples.en: The young playwright wrote a play about school life.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的劇作家寫了一齣關於校園生活的戲。

examples.en: Our drama club invited a playwright to talk about writing.
examples.zh: 我們的戲劇社邀請了一位劇作家來談寫作。

examples.en: The farmer pulled the plow across the field with two oxen.
examples.zh: 農夫用兩頭牛拉著犁穿過田野。

examples.en: In the old days, people used a wooden plow to prepare the soil.
examples.zh: 以前的人用木犁來整地。

examples.en: A snow plow cleared the road early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一早除雪車就把道路清乾淨了。

examples.en: Farmers plow their fields before they plant rice.
examples.zh: 農夫在種稻之前先犁田。

examples.en: The tractor plowed the field in just two hours.
examples.zh: 曳引機只花了兩小時就把田犁好了。

examples.en: The ship plowed through the rough waves.
examples.zh: 這艘船破浪前進。

examples.en: He stayed in the hospital for a week because of pneumonia.
examples.zh: 他因為肺炎住院一週。

examples.en: Pneumonia is more dangerous for babies and older people.
examples.zh: 肺炎對嬰兒和老年人更危險。

examples.en: The doctor said her cough might be a sign of pneumonia.
examples.zh: 醫生說她咳嗽可能是肺炎的徵兆。

examples.en: Polar bears live in the Arctic region.
examples.zh: 北極熊生活在北極地區。

examples.en: Scientists are studying how polar ice affects the sea level.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究極地冰層如何影響海平面。

examples.en: Temperatures in the polar regions can drop far below zero.
examples.zh: 極地地區的氣溫可能降到遠低於零度。

examples.en: She sat by the window and pondered her future.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗邊，思考自己的未來。

examples.en: I need some time to ponder your offer.
examples.zh: 我需要一些時間仔細考慮你的提議。

examples.en: The students pondered the question before they answered.
examples.zh: 學生們在回答前先仔細想了想這個問題。

examples.en: Millions of people populate the island's large cities.
examples.zh: 數百萬人居住在這座島的大城市裡。

examples.en: The area was first populated by farmers about 500 years ago.
examples.zh: 這個地區大約在五百年前首次有農民居住。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to populate the chart with the survey results.
examples.zh: 老師要我們把調查結果填入圖表。

examples.en: Good posture can help prevent back pain.
examples.zh: 良好的姿勢有助於預防背痛。

examples.en: Check your posture while you work at the computer.
examples.zh: 用電腦工作時，要留意自己的姿勢。

examples.en: The company changed its posture on pricing after hearing from customers.
examples.zh: 公司在聽取顧客意見後，改變了價格方面的立場。

examples.en: This potent cough syrup can make you sleepy.
examples.zh: 這種強效咳嗽糖漿可能讓你想睡。

examples.en: Social media can be a potent tool for small businesses.
examples.zh: 社群媒體對小型企業來說可能是強大的工具。

examples.en: Her speech was a potent reminder of the importance of kindness.
examples.zh: 她的演講有力地提醒了大家善良的重要。

examples.en: The pastor preaches every Sunday morning at our church.
examples.zh: 牧師每週日早上在我們的教會講道。

examples.en: My brother always preaches about saving money but spends it all.
examples.zh: 我哥哥總愛說教要存錢，自己卻把錢都花光。

examples.en: The doctor preached the benefits of regular exercise to his patients.
examples.zh: 醫生向病人宣導規律運動的好處。

examples.en: A short video will precede the main speech.
examples.zh: 一段短片會在主要演講之前播放。

examples.en: Dark clouds often precede a heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 烏雲通常出現在大雨之前。

examples.en: The letter A precedes B in the alphabet.
examples.zh: 在字母表中，A 排在 B 的前面。

examples.en: If we let one student leave early, it may set a precedent.
examples.zh: 如果我們讓一位學生提早離開，可能會開先例。

examples.en: Such a result has no precedent in our school's history.
examples.zh: 這樣的結果在我們學校的歷史上沒有先例。

examples.en: The judge followed the precedent set by an earlier court.
examples.zh: 法官遵循了先前法院所確立的先例。

examples.en: The watch was made with great precision.
examples.zh: 這支手錶以極高的精確度製成。

examples.en: Surgeons need precision and steady hands to perform complicated operations.
examples.zh: 外科醫師進行複雜手術時，需要精準的操作和穩定的雙手。

examples.en: The machine can measure small objects with remarkable precision.
examples.zh: 這台機器能以驚人的準確度測量小型物體。

examples.en: The new manager is friendlier than her predecessor.
examples.zh: 新經理比她的前任更親切。

examples.en: This phone is faster than its predecessor.
examples.zh: 這支手機比前一代更快。

examples.en: The company's predecessor was a small shop opened in 1950.
examples.zh: 這家公司的前身是一九五〇年開的一間小店。

examples.en: Scientists found prehistoric tools in a cave near the sea.
examples.zh: 科學家在海邊附近的洞穴裡發現了史前工具。

examples.en: We saw a prehistoric skeleton at the science museum.
examples.zh: 我們在科學博物館看到一具史前的骨骸。

examples.en: Cave paintings show how prehistoric people hunted.
examples.zh: 洞穴壁畫顯示史前人類如何狩獵。

examples.en: The premiere of the new movie will be held in Taipei tonight.
examples.zh: 這部新電影的首映會今晚在台北舉行。

examples.en: Fans waited outside the theater for the premiere.
examples.zh: 影迷們在戲院外等候首映。

examples.en: Tickets for the premiere of the school play sold out quickly.
examples.zh: 校內戲劇首演的票很快就賣完了。

examples.en: The new drama will premiere on Friday night.
examples.zh: 這部新影集將在週五晚上首播。

examples.en: Her documentary premiered at a film festival in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 她的紀錄片在東京的影展首次放映。

examples.en: The orchestra will premiere a new piece this spring.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團今年春天將首演一首新曲。

examples.en: The mayor will preside at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長將主持開幕典禮。

examples.en: Our principal presides over the weekly staff meeting.
examples.zh: 校長主持每週的教職員會議。

examples.en: The senior member presided at the dinner and welcomed the guests.
examples.zh: 資深會員主持了晚宴並歡迎賓客。

examples.en: The university has great prestige around the world.
examples.zh: 這所大學在全世界享有很高的聲望。

examples.en: Winning the national prize brought prestige to our school.
examples.zh: 贏得全國大獎為我們學校帶來了聲譽。

examples.en: Some people buy expensive watches for prestige.
examples.zh: 有些人為了聲望而買昂貴的手錶。

examples.en: Regular check-ups are an important preventive measure.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查是重要的預防措施。

examples.en: Preventive care can save families a lot of money later.
examples.zh: 預防性的照護日後能為家庭省下很多錢。

examples.en: The city took preventive steps to avoid flooding before the typhoon.
examples.zh: 市府在颱風來臨前採取預防措施以避免淹水。

examples.en: The museum keeps a priceless painting in a glass case.
examples.zh: 博物館把一幅無價的畫作放在玻璃櫃裡。

examples.en: Time with my grandparents is priceless to me.
examples.zh: 和祖父母相處的時光對我來說是無價的。

examples.en: The old photo is priceless because it shows my family many years ago.
examples.zh: 這張舊照片非常珍貴，因為它記錄了我家多年前的樣子。

examples.en: The government plans to privatize the railway company.
examples.zh: 政府計畫將這家鐵路公司民營化。

examples.en: Some people think it is a mistake to privatize water services.
examples.zh: 有些人認為將供水服務民營化是個錯誤。

examples.en: The airline was privatized in the 1990s.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司在一九九〇年代民營化了。

examples.en: Scientists sent a space probe to study Mars.
examples.zh: 科學家發射太空探測器來研究火星。

examples.en: The dentist used a thin probe to check my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙醫用一支細探針檢查我的牙齒。

examples.en: The school started a probe into the missing money.
examples.zh: 學校對遺失的款項展開調查。

examples.en: The reporter probed deeper into the cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 記者更深入調查延誤的原因。

examples.en: The teacher probed gently to find out why Tom was upset.
examples.zh: 老師委婉地探問，想知道湯姆為什麼不開心。

examples.en: Engineers will probe the ocean floor with a robot.
examples.zh: 工程師將用機器人探查海底。

examples.en: A long procession of cars followed the bride's car.
examples.zh: 一長列車輛跟在新娘的車後面。

examples.en: The temple procession moved slowly through the market street.
examples.zh: 廟會的遊行隊伍緩緩穿過市場街道。

examples.en: Children in costumes joined the festival procession.
examples.zh: 穿著服裝的孩子們加入了慶典的遊行隊伍。

examples.en: Her proficiency in English helped her get the job.
examples.zh: 她的英語能力幫助她得到了這份工作。

examples.en: You must show proficiency in math to enter this class.
examples.zh: 你必須展現數學方面的熟練程度才能進入這個班級。

examples.en: The test measures your proficiency in speaking and listening.
examples.zh: 這項測驗衡量你在口說和聽力方面的能力。

examples.en: There is a strict prohibition on smoking in the building.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓內對吸菸有嚴格的禁令。

examples.en: The school announced a prohibition on bringing phones to exams.
examples.zh: 學校宣布禁止攜帶手機進考場。

examples.en: Many people did not agree with the prohibition of fishing in the lake.
examples.zh: 許多人不同意禁止在湖裡釣魚的規定。

examples.en: Strong wind propelled the small boat across the lake.
examples.zh: 強風推著小船橫越湖面。

examples.en: Her hard work propelled her to the top of the class.
examples.zh: 她的努力推動她登上班上第一名。

examples.en: The engine burns fuel to propel the rocket into space.
examples.zh: 引擎燃燒燃料，將火箭推向太空。

examples.en: He writes poems, but his prose is also beautiful.
examples.zh: 他寫詩，但他的散文也很優美。

examples.en: The novel is written in simple, clear prose.
examples.zh: 這部小說的文字簡單清楚。

examples.en: Students often find poetry harder to understand than prose.
examples.zh: 學生常覺得詩比散文更難懂。

examples.en: The company was prosecuted for dumping waste in the river.
examples.zh: 該公司因為把廢棄物倒入河中而遭到起訴。

examples.en: Anyone who steals from the store will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 任何在店裡偷東西的人都會被起訴。

examples.en: It is the prosecutor's job to prosecute people who break the law.
examples.zh: 檢察官的工作是起訴違法的人。

examples.en: The school held a tour for prospective students and their parents.
examples.zh: 學校為未來的學生和家長舉辦了參觀活動。

examples.en: We met a prospective buyer who wanted to see the apartment.
examples.zh: 我們見了一位想看公寓的潛在買家。

examples.en: The company is talking to several prospective partners.
examples.zh: 公司正與幾位潛在的合作夥伴洽談。

examples.en: The engineers built a prototype of the electric scooter.
examples.zh: 工程師們製作了電動機車的原型。

examples.en: The first prototype was too heavy, so the team redesigned it.
examples.zh: 第一個原型太重，所以團隊重新設計了它。

examples.en: Students presented a prototype of their app to the judges.
examples.zh: 學生們向評審展示了他們應用程式的原型。

examples.en: The provincial capital is a busy city of three million people.
examples.zh: 省會是個擁有三百萬人口的繁忙城市。

examples.en: The provincial government built a new highway.
examples.zh: 省政府興建了一條新公路。

examples.en: She grew up in a small provincial town.
examples.zh: 她在一個地方小鎮長大。

examples.en: The team set up a provisional office until the building was ready.
examples.zh: 在大樓完工前，團隊先設置了臨時辦公室。

examples.en: He got a provisional offer, which still needs final approval.
examples.zh: 他收到一份暫定的錄取通知，仍需最後核准。

examples.en: The provisional schedule may change next week.
examples.zh: 暫定的時間表下週可能會更動。

examples.en: She decided to study psychiatry after working in a hospital.
examples.zh: 她在醫院工作後，決定攻讀精神醫學。

examples.en: The hospital has a special department of psychiatry.
examples.zh: 這家醫院設有專門的精神科。

examples.en: Advances in psychiatry have helped many people with depression.
examples.zh: 精神醫學的進步幫助了許多憂鬱症患者。

examples.en: The woman claims to have psychic powers.
examples.zh: 那位女士聲稱自己有通靈的能力。

examples.en: The movie is about a girl with psychic abilities.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一位擁有通靈能力的女孩。

examples.en: Are you psychic? You always know what I am thinking!
examples.zh: 你會通靈嗎？你總是知道我在想什麼！

examples.en: A psychic told her she would travel to Europe.
examples.zh: 一位靈媒告訴她，她將前往歐洲旅行。

examples.en: Some people visit a psychic when they are unsure about their future.
examples.zh: 有些人對未來感到不確定時會去找靈媒。

examples.en: The psychic closed her eyes and held the stranger's hand.
examples.zh: 靈媒閉上眼睛，握住陌生人的手。

examples.en: The club made posters to publicize the school concert.
examples.zh: 社團製作海報來宣傳學校音樂會。

examples.en: The company publicized its new product on social media.
examples.zh: 公司在社群媒體上宣傳了新產品。

examples.en: She did not want to publicize her private life.
examples.zh: 她不想公開自己的私生活。

examples.en: A puff of wind blew the papers off my desk.
examples.zh: 一陣風把我桌上的紙吹落了。

examples.en: There was a small puff of smoke from the chimney.
examples.zh: 煙囪冒出一小團煙。

examples.en: She took a puff from her inhaler before the race.
examples.zh: 她在比賽前用吸入器吸了一口藥。

examples.en: Smoke puffed out of the old train's chimney.
examples.zh: 老火車的煙囪冒出陣陣煙霧。

examples.en: He was puffing after climbing the stairs to the fifth floor.
examples.zh: 他爬上五樓後氣喘吁吁。

examples.en: Her cheeks puffed out when she tried to hold her breath.
examples.zh: 她憋氣時雙頰鼓了起來。

examples.en: This machine can purify the water from the river.
examples.zh: 這台機器可以淨化河水。

examples.en: Plants help purify the air inside our homes.
examples.zh: 植物有助於淨化我們家中的空氣。

examples.en: Many people use filters to purify tap water before drinking it.
examples.zh: 許多人在飲用自來水前會用濾水器來淨化。

examples.en: The purity of the mountain water impressed all the visitors.
examples.zh: 山泉水的純淨讓所有遊客印象深刻。

examples.en: Gold jewelry is tested for purity before it goes on sale.
examples.zh: 金飾在上市前會先檢驗純度。

examples.en: The label says the salt has a purity of 99 percent.
examples.zh: 標籤上寫著這種鹽的純度為百分之九十九。

examples.en: A strong quake shook the city early in the morning.
examples.zh: 一場強震在清晨搖晃了整座城市。

examples.en: Many buildings were damaged in the quake last year.
examples.zh: 去年的地震使許多建築物受損。

examples.en: Schools hold drills so students know what to do in a quake.
examples.zh: 學校舉行演習，讓學生知道地震時該怎麼做。

examples.en: The old bridge quaked when the heavy truck drove across it.
examples.zh: 重型卡車駛過時，老橋隨之晃動。

examples.en: The whole building quaked as the train passed underneath.
examples.zh: 火車從下方經過時，整棟大樓都在搖晃。

examples.en: Her voice quaked with fear as she answered the phone.
examples.zh: 她接電話時聲音因害怕而顫抖。

senses.zh: 容光煥發的；燦爛的；明亮的

examples.en: The bride looked radiant in her white dress.
examples.zh: 新娘穿著白紗，看起來容光煥發。

examples.en: A radiant smile spread across her face when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 她看到禮物時，臉上綻放燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: The radiant sun lit up the whole valley.
examples.zh: 明亮的太陽照亮了整座山谷。

examples.en: The heater radiates heat to every corner of the room.
examples.zh: 暖氣機把熱量散發到房間的每個角落。

examples.en: She radiates confidence whenever she walks on stage.
examples.zh: 她每次走上舞台都散發著自信。

examples.en: Several roads radiate from the town square.
examples.zh: 幾條道路從市鎮廣場向四周延伸。

examples.en: Scientists study how radioactive materials change over time.
examples.zh: 科學家研究放射性物質如何隨時間變化。

examples.en: The hospital stores radioactive substances in special containers.
examples.zh: 醫院把放射性物質存放在特殊的容器裡。

examples.en: Radioactive waste must be handled with great care.
examples.zh: 放射性廢棄物必須非常小心處理。

examples.en: My grandmother added a sliced radish to the salad.
examples.zh: 我祖母在沙拉裡加了切片的小蘿蔔。

examples.en: The farmer pulled a big radish out of the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫從土裡拔出一根大蘿蔔。

examples.en: Radish soup is a popular dish during the winter.
examples.zh: 蘿蔔湯是冬天很受歡迎的一道菜。

examples.en: The radius of this circle is five centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個圓的半徑是五公分。

examples.en: There are three convenience stores within a one-kilometer radius.
examples.zh: 一公里範圍內有三家便利商店。

examples.en: The radius of the Earth is about 6,400 kilometers.
examples.zh: 地球的半徑約為六千四百公里。

senses.zh: 饒舌音樂；饒舌歌；輕敲聲

examples.en: My brother loves rap and listens to it on the bus.
examples.zh: 我哥哥喜歡饒舌，搭公車時也在聽。

examples.en: She wrote a rap about her school for the talent show.
examples.zh: 她為才藝表演寫了一首關於學校的饒舌歌。

examples.en: A sharp rap on the classroom door interrupted the lesson.
examples.zh: 教室門上傳來一聲急促的敲門聲，打斷了課程。

examples.en: Someone rapped on the door while I was cooking.
examples.zh: 我煮飯時有人敲了門。

examples.en: The teacher rapped the desk to get the class's attention.
examples.zh: 老師敲了敲桌子，吸引全班的注意。

examples.en: He learned to rap by practicing the rhythm of his favorite songs.
examples.zh: 他藉由練習最喜愛歌曲的節奏，學習饒舌演唱。

examples.en: The baby has a red rash on her arm.
examples.zh: 這個嬰兒的手臂上有紅疹。

examples.en: A rash appeared on his neck after he ate the shrimp.
examples.zh: 他吃了蝦子後，脖子上起了疹子。

examples.en: The doctor gave me some cream for the rash.
examples.zh: 醫生給了我一些治療皮疹的藥膏。

examples.en: It was a rash decision to quit without another job.
examples.zh: 沒有另一份工作就辭職是個輕率的決定。

examples.en: Don't make a rash promise you cannot keep.
examples.zh: 不要做出你無法兌現的輕率承諾。

examples.en: He regretted his rash words after the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議後後悔自己那些魯莽的話。

examples.en: The council will ratify the new agreement next week.
examples.zh: 委員會下週將批准這項新協議。

examples.en: Both countries must ratify the treaty before it takes effect.
examples.zh: 兩國在條約生效前都必須批准該條約。

examples.en: Members voted to ratify the changes to the club rules.
examples.zh: 會員投票通過了對社團規章的修改。

examples.en: She came to the realization that she needed more sleep.
examples.zh: 她領悟到自己需要更多睡眠。

examples.en: The realization of his dream took ten years of hard work.
examples.zh: 他花了十年努力才實現夢想。

examples.en: There is a growing realization that we must protect the environment.
examples.zh: 人們愈來愈體認到我們必須保護環境。

examples.en: Farmers reap the rice in the fall.
examples.zh: 農夫在秋天收割稻米。

examples.en: Students who study regularly will reap the benefits at exam time.
examples.zh: 規律讀書的學生在考試時會獲得成果。

examples.en: We reaped a good harvest of apples this year.
examples.zh: 今年我們的蘋果大豐收。

examples.en: Reckless driving causes many accidents on the highway.
examples.zh: 魯莽駕駛在高速公路上造成許多事故。

examples.en: It was reckless of him to swim in the river alone.
examples.zh: 他獨自在河裡游泳真是魯莽。

examples.en: The manager warned the team against reckless spending.
examples.zh: 經理警告團隊不要不顧後果地亂花錢。

examples.en: I reckon it will rain before we get to the park.
examples.zh: 我想我們到公園前就會下雨了。

examples.en: They reckon the trip will take about three hours.
examples.zh: 他們估計這趟旅程大約要三小時。

examples.en: What do you reckon we should buy for her birthday?
examples.zh: 你覺得我們該買什麼當她的生日禮物？

examples.en: The two sisters finally reconciled after a long argument.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹在長時間爭吵後終於和好了。

examples.en: It is hard to reconcile work with a busy family life.
examples.zh: 要讓工作與忙碌的家庭生活取得平衡很難。

examples.en: The accountant must reconcile the bank statement with the company's records.
examples.zh: 會計必須核對銀行對帳單與公司帳冊。

examples.en: The park offers many recreational activities for families.
examples.zh: 這座公園為家庭提供許多休閒活動。

examples.en: The school built a new recreational center for students.
examples.zh: 學校為學生蓋了一座新的娛樂中心。

examples.en: Swimming is a popular recreational sport in summer.
examples.zh: 游泳是夏天很受歡迎的休閒運動。

examples.en: The report contains a lot of redundancy and should be shorter.
examples.zh: 這份報告有很多冗餘內容，應該再精簡。

examples.en: Many workers lost their jobs because of redundancy at the factory.
examples.zh: 工廠裁員使許多員工失去工作。

examples.en: Backup systems add redundancy to keep the network running.
examples.zh: 備援系統增加冗餘，確保網路持續運作。

examples.en: Divers came to see the colorful fish around the reef.
examples.zh: 潛水客來看珊瑚礁周圍色彩繽紛的魚。

examples.en: The boat hit a reef and began to take in water.
examples.zh: 船撞上礁石，開始進水。

examples.en: Pollution is damaging the reef near the island.
examples.zh: 污染正在破壞島嶼附近的珊瑚礁。

examples.en: The referee blew the whistle to start the game.
examples.zh: 裁判吹哨宣布比賽開始。

examples.en: A referee must treat both teams fairly.
examples.zh: 裁判必須公平對待兩隊。

examples.en: She listed her former manager as a referee on her job application.
examples.zh: 她在求職申請中把前主管列為推薦人。

examples.en: The country will hold a referendum on the new law next month.
examples.zh: 該國下個月將就新法舉行公民投票。

examples.en: Voters rejected the plan in a referendum.
examples.zh: 選民在公民投票中否決了這項計畫。

examples.en: A referendum was held to decide whether to build the new stadium.
examples.zh: 為了決定是否興建新體育場，舉行了公民投票。

examples.en: The factory refines raw sugar before shipping it to stores.
examples.zh: 這間工廠先精煉粗糖，再把糖運送到商店。

examples.en: She spent the weekend refining her speech.
examples.zh: 她花了整個週末潤飾她的演講稿。

examples.en: Engineers continue to refine the design of the engine.
examples.zh: 工程師持續改良引擎的設計。

examples.en: Cyclists should wear reflective vests at night.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人晚上應該穿反光背心。

examples.en: He was in a reflective mood after the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮後，他若有所思。

examples.en: Writing a journal is a reflective habit that helps me learn.
examples.zh: 寫日記是一種幫助我學習的反思習慣。

examples.en: Refreshments will be served after the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議結束後將供應茶點。

examples.en: The cool shower brought welcome refreshment after a long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，沖個涼令人恢復精神，十分舒暢。

examples.en: The school provided light refreshments for the visiting parents.
examples.zh: 學校為來訪的家長準備了簡單的點心。

examples.en: The scientist used new data to refute the claim.
examples.zh: 科學家用新的數據駁斥那項說法。

examples.en: She quickly refuted every point in his argument.
examples.zh: 她迅速反駁了他論點中的每一項。

examples.en: The company refuted the rumor that it would close the store.
examples.zh: 公司駁斥了將關閉該店的傳聞。

examples.en: The clinic helps patients rehabilitate after serious knee injuries.
examples.zh: 這間診所協助病患在嚴重膝傷後復健。

examples.en: The city plans to rehabilitate the old train station.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫修復這座舊火車站。

examples.en: Volunteers rehabilitate injured wild birds before releasing them.
examples.zh: 志工讓受傷的野鳥恢復健康後再放生。

examples.en: The castle was built during the reign of King Henry.
examples.zh: 這座城堡是在亨利國王在位期間建造的。

examples.en: Her reign lasted for more than sixty years.
examples.zh: 她的統治持續了六十多年。

examples.en: Peace and trade grew during his long reign.
examples.zh: 在他漫長的統治期間，和平與貿易逐漸發展。

examples.en: The king reigned over a peaceful country for forty years.
examples.zh: 國王統治一個和平的國家長達四十年。

examples.en: Silence reigned in the library during exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週期間，圖書館裡一片寂靜。

examples.en: Our team has reigned as the school champion for three years.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍已連續三年稱霸全校。

examples.en: The whole town rejoiced when the team won the final.
examples.zh: 球隊贏得決賽時，全鎮歡欣鼓舞。

examples.en: We rejoice in the good news about her recovery.
examples.zh: 我們為她康復的好消息感到欣喜。

examples.en: Children rejoiced at the first snow of the year.
examples.zh: 孩子們為今年的第一場雪歡欣雀躍。

examples.en: Our class won the relay on sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班在運動會的接力賽中獲勝。

examples.en: The relay switches the motor on when the sensor detects movement.
examples.zh: 感測器偵測到移動時，繼電器會啟動馬達。

examples.en: A signal relay on the mountain improved the phone coverage.
examples.zh: 山上的訊號中繼站改善了手機收訊。

examples.en: Please relay my thanks to your parents.
examples.zh: 請代我向你的父母轉達謝意。

examples.en: The station will relay the concert live to millions of viewers.
examples.zh: 電視台將向數百萬觀眾現場轉播這場演唱會。

examples.en: Satellites relay phone calls across the ocean.
examples.zh: 衛星跨越海洋傳送電話通話。

examples.en: The team faced relentless pressure from the crowd.
examples.zh: 球隊面對來自觀眾不間斷的壓力。

examples.en: Her relentless effort finally earned her a scholarship.
examples.zh: 她堅持不懈的努力終於為她贏得獎學金。

examples.en: The relentless heat made it hard to work outdoors.
examples.zh: 毫不間斷的酷熱讓人很難在戶外工作。

examples.en: Our reliance on cell phones keeps growing every year.
examples.zh: 我們對手機的依賴逐年增加。

examples.en: The island's reliance on tourism is a concern for the government.
examples.zh: 這座島對觀光業的依賴令政府擔憂。

examples.en: Teachers hope to reduce students' reliance on dictionaries.
examples.zh: 老師希望減少學生對字典的依賴。

examples.en: The museum displays relics from an ancient temple.
examples.zh: 博物館展出一座古代廟宇的遺物。

examples.en: This old watch is a relic of my grandfather's time.
examples.zh: 這支舊手錶是我祖父那個年代的遺物。

examples.en: Some people think paper maps are a relic of the past.
examples.zh: 有些人認為紙本地圖是過時的東西。

examples.en: I will finish the remainder of the homework tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚會把剩下的功課寫完。

examples.en: Divide twelve by five and the remainder is two.
examples.zh: 十二除以五，餘數是二。

examples.en: The remainder of the money will go to the school library.
examples.zh: 剩下的錢將交給學校圖書館。

examples.en: The smell of the soup is reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen.
examples.zh: 這湯的香味讓人想起祖母的廚房。

examples.en: Her style of painting is reminiscent of Monet.
examples.zh: 她的畫風讓人聯想到莫內。

examples.en: The old town has a charm reminiscent of a fairy tale.
examples.zh: 這座老城的魅力讓人聯想到童話故事。

examples.en: The city is renowned for its beautiful night markets.
examples.zh: 這座城市以美麗的夜市聞名。

examples.en: She is a renowned scientist who studies ocean life.
examples.zh: 她是一位研究海洋生物的知名科學家。

examples.en: The renowned chef opened a new restaurant downtown.
examples.zh: 這位名廚在市中心開了一家新餐廳。

examples.en: Frogs reproduce by laying eggs in the water.
examples.zh: 青蛙在水中產卵來繁殖。

examples.en: It is illegal to reproduce this book without permission.
examples.zh: 未經許可複製這本書是違法的。

examples.en: The scientists could not reproduce the results of the experiment.
examples.zh: 科學家無法重現這項實驗的結果。

examples.en: A snake is a reptile that has no legs.
examples.zh: 蛇是一種沒有腳的爬蟲類。

examples.en: The zoo has a special house for reptiles.
examples.zh: 動物園有一間專門的爬蟲館。

examples.en: Most reptiles lay eggs and need warmth from the sun.
examples.zh: 大多數爬蟲類會產卵，並需要太陽的溫暖。

examples.en: She resented her brother for getting all the attention.
examples.zh: 她怨恨哥哥獨占所有關注。

examples.en: He resented having to clean the house alone.
examples.zh: 他對必須獨自打掃房子感到不滿。

examples.en: Many employees resent the new rules about working hours.
examples.zh: 許多員工對新的工時規定感到憤慨。

examples.en: My aunt resides in Tainan with her family.
examples.zh: 我阿姨和家人住在台南。

examples.en: Students who reside outside the city can apply for a dormitory.
examples.zh: 住在市區以外的學生可以申請宿舍。

examples.en: Foreign researchers who reside in Taiwan often attend local academic conferences.
examples.zh: 居住在臺灣的外籍研究人員經常參加當地的學術研討會。

examples.en: The two students returned to their respective classrooms.
examples.zh: 兩位學生回到各自的教室。

examples.en: Parents and teachers have their respective roles in a child's education.
examples.zh: 家長和老師在孩子的教育中各有其角色。

examples.en: Please write your answers in the respective boxes.
examples.zh: 請把答案寫在各自對應的方框內。

examples.en: She tried to restrain her anger during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她試著在會議中壓抑怒氣。

examples.en: Please restrain your dog while the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 賓客抵達時，請管好你的狗。

examples.en: He could not restrain a laugh when he saw the cat's face.
examples.zh: 他看到貓的表情時忍不住笑了出來。

examples.en: The player showed great restraint and did not shout at the referee.
examples.zh: 球員表現出極大的克制，沒有對裁判大吼。

examples.en: The company asked staff to show restraint when spending on trips.
examples.zh: 公司要求員工出差時節制花費。

examples.en: A seat belt is a restraint that protects drivers in a crash.
examples.zh: 安全帶是一種在車禍時保護駕駛的約束裝置。

examples.en: "I did not break it!" he retorted.
examples.zh: 「我沒有弄壞它！」他反駁道。

examples.en: When I said the movie was boring, she retorted that I never liked anything.
examples.zh: 我說電影很無聊時，她回嘴說我從來沒喜歡過任何東西。

examples.en: Nobody dared to retort when the manager made his decision.
examples.zh: 經理做出決定時，沒有人敢回嘴。

examples.en: He climbed over the fence to retrieve the ball.
examples.zh: 他爬過圍欄去撿回球。

examples.en: You can retrieve your files from the cloud at any time.
examples.zh: 你可以隨時從雲端取回檔案。

examples.en: Trained dogs can retrieve birds that fall into the water.
examples.zh: 受過訓練的狗能把掉進水裡的鳥叼回來。

senses.zh: 揭露；令人大開眼界的事

examples.en: The revelation of the secret surprised the whole family.
examples.zh: 秘密被揭露讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Her speech was a revelation to many of us.
examples.zh: 她的演講對我們許多人是一大啟發。

examples.en: Visiting the farm was a revelation for the city kids.
examples.zh: 參觀農場對城市孩子來說是令人大開眼界的事。

examples.en: The city is enjoying a revival of interest in traditional crafts.
examples.zh: 這座城市對傳統工藝的興趣正在復甦。

examples.en: The economy showed a slow revival after the crisis.
examples.zh: 經濟在危機後緩慢復甦。

examples.en: The theater announced a revival of the famous musical.
examples.zh: 劇院宣布重演這齣著名的音樂劇。

senses.zh: 使甦醒；重振；使恢復精神

examples.en: The nurse tried to revive the man who had fainted.
examples.zh: 護理師試著讓昏倒的男子甦醒。

examples.en: The new mayor wants to revive the old market.
examples.zh: 新市長想重振這座舊市場。

examples.en: A cup of coffee helped revive me after the long trip.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡幫我在漫長的旅程後恢復精神。

examples.en: The students organized a revolt against the unfair school rule.
examples.zh: 學生發起反抗那條不公平校規的行動。

examples.en: Peasants rose in revolt against the heavy taxes.
examples.zh: 農民起身反抗沉重的稅賦。

examples.en: The revolt spread quickly across the country.
examples.zh: 叛亂迅速蔓延全國。

examples.en: The workers revolted against the long working hours.
examples.zh: 工人起而反抗過長的工時。

examples.en: The young soldiers revolted against their commander.
examples.zh: 年輕的士兵起而反抗他們的指揮官。

examples.en: The smell of the rotten fish revolted everyone in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 腐爛魚的氣味讓廚房裡的每個人都感到厭惡。

examples.en: The Earth revolves around the sun once a year.
examples.zh: 地球每年繞著太陽公轉一圈。

examples.en: The wheel revolved slowly in the wind.
examples.zh: 輪子在風中緩緩轉動。

examples.en: Her life revolves around her family and her work.
examples.zh: 她的生活圍繞著家人和工作。

examples.en: The school has a rigorous process for choosing new teachers.
examples.zh: 學校有一套嚴格的流程來遴選新老師。

examples.en: She did rigorous research before writing her report.
examples.zh: 她寫報告之前做了嚴謹的研究。

examples.en: Athletes follow a rigorous training schedule before the national games.
examples.zh: 運動員在全國運動會之前遵循嚴格的訓練計畫。

examples.en: A small stone made ripples across the quiet pond.
examples.zh: 一顆小石頭在平靜的池塘上激起了漣漪。

examples.en: You could see the ripple behind the little boat.
examples.zh: 你可以看到小船後方的波紋。

examples.en: The news caused a ripple of excitement in the classroom.
examples.zh: 這則消息在教室裡引起一陣興奮的騷動。

examples.en: Wind made the surface of the lake ripple.
examples.zh: 風使湖面泛起漣漪。

examples.en: The flag rippled in the gentle breeze.
examples.zh: 旗子在微風中飄動。

examples.en: Laughter rippled through the audience during the speech.
examples.zh: 演講期間，笑聲在觀眾之間傳開來。

examples.en: There is a friendly rivalry between the two classes.
examples.zh: 兩個班級之間存在著良性的競爭。

examples.en: The rivalry between the two companies lasted for years.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司之間的競爭持續了好幾年。

examples.en: Their rivalry began when they both applied for the same job.
examples.zh: 他們兩人都申請同一份工作時，彼此的競爭就開始了。

examples.en: Cattle roam freely across the grassy hills.
examples.zh: 牛群在長滿青草的山丘上自由漫遊。

examples.en: The tourists roamed the old streets all afternoon.
examples.zh: 觀光客整個下午都在老街上閒逛。

examples.en: A stray dog roamed around the parking lot looking for food.
examples.zh: 一隻流浪狗在停車場附近徘徊，想找東西吃。

examples.en: This robust table can hold a lot of heavy books.
examples.zh: 這張堅固的桌子可以放很多沉重的書。

examples.en: The country has a robust economy despite the global slowdown.
examples.zh: 儘管全球景氣放緩，這個國家的經濟仍然穩健。

examples.en: He has a robust body from years of playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他多年來打籃球，所以身體很強健。

examples.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 地球每二十四小時自轉一圈。

examples.en: Please rotate the picture so it faces the right way.
examples.zh: 請把這張圖片旋轉，讓它朝向正確的方向。

examples.en: Our team members rotate the cleaning duty each week.
examples.zh: 我們組員每週輪流負責打掃。

examples.en: The rotation of the Earth causes day and night.
examples.zh: 地球的自轉造成了白天與黑夜。

examples.en: The teacher set up a rotation for cleaning the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師排了教室打掃的輪值表。

examples.en: Farmers use crop rotation to keep the soil healthy.
examples.zh: 農夫利用輪作來維持土壤肥沃。

examples.en: Royalty from many countries attended the wedding.
examples.zh: 許多國家的王室成員都出席了婚禮。

examples.en: People bowed politely when royalty entered the hall.
examples.zh: 皇室成員走進大廳時，人們有禮貌地鞠躬。

examples.en: The singer earns royalties whenever her songs are played on the radio.
examples.zh: 這位歌手的歌每次在廣播中播放，她就能賺到版稅。

senses.zh: 崎嶇的；粗獷的；堅固耐用的

examples.en: We hiked across rugged mountains for three days.
examples.zh: 我們在崎嶇的山區健行了三天。

examples.en: The actor has a rugged face and a warm smile.
examples.zh: 這位演員有一張粗獷的臉龐和溫暖的笑容。

examples.en: I bought a rugged phone case that can survive a fall.
examples.zh: 我買了一個能承受摔落的堅固耐用手機殼。

examples.en: The ruthless manager cut costs without caring about the workers.
examples.zh: 這位無情的經理只顧削減成本，完全不在乎員工。

examples.en: Competition in the fashion business can be ruthless.
examples.zh: 時尚界的競爭可能非常殘酷。

examples.en: He was ruthless when choosing which players to keep on the team.
examples.zh: 他挑選要留在隊上的球員時毫不留情。

examples.en: The soldiers stood up straight to salute the flag.
examples.zh: 士兵們站得筆直，向國旗敬禮。

examples.en: The students rose to salute their retiring teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們起立，向即將退休的老師致敬。

examples.en: We salute the volunteers for their hard work.
examples.zh: 我們向志工們的辛勤付出致敬。

examples.en: The officer gave a quick salute to the crowd.
examples.zh: 軍官向群眾迅速敬了個禮。

examples.en: The parade ended with a salute to the national flag.
examples.zh: 遊行在向國旗敬禮中結束。

examples.en: This poster is a salute to all the nurses in our city.
examples.zh: 這張海報是向我們城市所有護理師致意。

examples.en: Workers tried to salvage the old books after the flood.
examples.zh: 工人們在水災過後設法搶救那些舊書。

examples.en: Divers will salvage the sunken ship next month.
examples.zh: 潛水員下個月將打撈那艘沉船。

examples.en: The coach tried to salvage the game with a new plan.
examples.zh: 教練試圖用新的戰術挽回這場比賽。

examples.en: Clean water and good sanitation protect people from disease.
examples.zh: 乾淨的水和良好的衛生設施能保護人們不生病。

examples.en: The city plans to improve sanitation in the old neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 市政府打算改善老社區的衛生設施。

examples.en: Poor sanitation in the camp caused many people to get sick.
examples.zh: 營地的衛生條件很差，讓許多人生了病。

examples.en: The critic wrote a savage review of the new movie.
examples.zh: 影評人對這部新電影寫了一篇嚴厲的評論。

examples.en: The savage storm damaged many houses along the coast.
examples.zh: 猛烈的暴風雨損壞了沿海的許多房屋。

examples.en: The hikers heard the savage cry of a wild animal.
examples.zh: 登山客聽到野獸凶猛的叫聲。

examples.en: We took a scenic route along the east coast.
examples.zh: 我們沿著東海岸走了一條風景優美的路線。

examples.en: The hotel is near a scenic lake surrounded by mountains.
examples.zh: 這間飯店靠近一座被群山環繞的優美湖泊。

examples.en: Many visitors enjoy the scenic view from the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 許多遊客喜歡山頂上的優美景色。

examples.en: He looked at the cheap gift with scorn.
examples.zh: 他輕蔑地看著那份廉價的禮物。

examples.en: Her idea was met with scorn by the older members.
examples.zh: 她的想法遭到資深成員的鄙視。

examples.en: The old man spoke of fast food with scorn.
examples.zh: 老先生談到速食時語帶輕蔑。

examples.en: Some people scorn those who ask for help.
examples.zh: 有些人瞧不起尋求幫助的人。

examples.en: She scorned the idea of cheating on the exam.
examples.zh: 她對在考試中作弊的想法嗤之以鼻。

examples.en: Critics scorned the film for its weak story.
examples.zh: 評論家因這部電影的劇情薄弱而對它嗤之以鼻。

examples.en: Please scrape the mud off your shoes before coming in.
examples.zh: 進來之前，請先把鞋上的泥巴刮掉。

examples.en: He fell off his bike and scraped his knee.
examples.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋擦傷了。

examples.en: The chair scraped against the floor with a loud noise.
examples.zh: 椅子在地板上摩擦，發出很大的聲音。

examples.en: The child had a small scrape on his elbow.
examples.zh: 小孩的手肘上有一處小擦傷。

examples.en: A scrape on the car door needs to be repaired.
examples.zh: 車門上的刮痕需要修補。

examples.en: I heard the scrape of a chair in the next room.
examples.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來椅子的刮擦聲。

examples.en: I need a screwdriver to fix the loose chair.
examples.zh: 我需要一支螺絲起子來修理鬆掉的椅子。

examples.en: Please hand me the small screwdriver on the table.
examples.zh: 請把桌上那支小螺絲起子遞給我。

examples.en: He opened the back of the radio with a screwdriver.
examples.zh: 他用螺絲起子打開收音機的背板。

examples.en: Scroll down to see the rest of the page.
examples.zh: 向下捲動就能看到頁面其餘的部分。

examples.en: She scrolled through her messages while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 她等公車時捲動畫面查看訊息。

examples.en: You can scroll with the wheel on the mouse.
examples.zh: 你可以用滑鼠的滾輪來捲動畫面。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a scroll that was over one hundred years old.
examples.zh: 老師給我們看了一幅有一百多年歷史的卷軸。

examples.en: The scroll showed a long painting of a river.
examples.zh: 這幅畫卷畫出了一條長長的河流。

examples.en: A scroll with a poem hung on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上掛著一幅寫著詩的卷軸。

examples.en: The new law is under close scrutiny by the public.
examples.zh: 這項新法律受到大眾的嚴格審視。

examples.en: The company's accounts came under scrutiny after the report.
examples.zh: 報告發表後，該公司的帳目受到嚴格審查。

examples.en: Her scrutiny of the contract revealed several mistakes.
examples.zh: 她仔細檢查合約，發現了幾處錯誤。

examples.en: The sculptor spent three months carving the stone lion.
examples.zh: 這位雕刻家花了三個月雕刻那隻石獅。

examples.en: A famous sculptor will visit our art class on Friday.
examples.zh: 一位知名的雕刻家星期五會來我們的美術課。

examples.en: My uncle is a sculptor who makes small wooden animals.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是雕刻家，專門製作小型木頭動物。

examples.en: The low price seduced many customers into buying more.
examples.zh: 低廉的價格誘使許多顧客買得更多。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread seduced me into the bakery.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味誘使我走進了麵包店。

examples.en: Advertising can seduce young people into spending too much.
examples.zh: 廣告可能誘使年輕人過度消費。

examples.en: The university is very selective about the students it accepts.
examples.zh: 這所大學在錄取學生時篩選得很嚴格。

examples.en: My cat is selective about what she eats.
examples.zh: 我的貓對吃的東西很挑剔。

examples.en: Be selective when you share personal information online.
examples.zh: 在網路上分享個人資訊時要有所選擇。

examples.en: The lake looked serene in the early morning light.
examples.zh: 清晨的光線下，湖面顯得很寧靜。

examples.en: She gave me a serene smile before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前，她對我露出安詳的微笑。

examples.en: We enjoyed a serene weekend in a small mountain village.
examples.zh: 我們在一個小山村度過了平靜的週末。

examples.en: The sergeant told the new soldiers to line up outside.
examples.zh: 中士要新兵到外面排隊。

examples.en: My grandfather retired as a sergeant in the army.
examples.zh: 我祖父以陸軍中士的身分退伍。

examples.en: A police sergeant helped us find our way to the station.
examples.zh: 一位警長協助我們找到去車站的路。

examples.en: Each camera has a unique serial number on the bottom.
examples.zh: 每台相機底部都有獨一無二的序號。

examples.en: The magazine will publish the story in serial form.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌將以連載的形式刊登這個故事。

examples.en: He watched a serial drama about a family restaurant.
examples.zh: 他看了一部以家庭餐廳為背景的連續劇。

examples.en: My grandmother loves watching the evening serial on TV.
examples.zh: 我祖母喜歡看電視上的晚間連續劇。

examples.en: The children's magazine runs a weekly serial about a talking dog.
examples.zh: 這本兒童雜誌每週連載一個關於會說話的狗的故事。

examples.en: The radio serial continued for two years.
examples.zh: 這部廣播連續劇播了兩年。

examples.en: The priest gave a short sermon about kindness.
examples.zh: 神父做了一場關於善良的簡短講道。

examples.en: My father gave me a sermon about being on time.
examples.zh: 父親對我說教了一番，要我準時。

examples.en: The church was full for the Sunday sermon.
examples.zh: 星期日講道時，教堂裡坐滿了人。

examples.en: The restaurant gives each guest a large serving of rice.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳給每位客人一大份飯。

examples.en: One serving of this soup has only eighty calories.
examples.zh: 這種湯一份只有八十大卡。

examples.en: Would you like a second serving of salad?
examples.zh: 你想再來一份沙拉嗎？

examples.en: The injury was a big setback for the young player.
examples.zh: 這次受傷對這位年輕球員來說是一大挫折。

examples.en: We faced a setback when the funding was cut.
examples.zh: 經費被刪減時，我們遭遇了阻礙。

examples.en: Don't let one setback stop you from trying again.
examples.zh: 別讓一次挫折阻止你再試一次。

examples.en: The old shop had a shabby sign above the door.
examples.zh: 這家老店的門上掛著一塊破舊的招牌。

examples.en: She wore a shabby dress but still carried herself with pride.
examples.zh: 她穿著寒酸的洋裝，卻仍然昂首挺胸。

examples.en: That was a shabby way to treat a friend.
examples.zh: 那樣對待朋友太卑劣了。

examples.en: Please shred these old documents before you throw them away.
examples.zh: 請在丟棄這些舊文件之前先把它們絞碎。

examples.en: I shredded some cabbage for the salad.
examples.zh: 我把一些高麗菜切成細絲來做沙拉。

examples.en: The cat shredded the curtain with its sharp claws.
examples.zh: 貓用尖銳的爪子把窗簾撕碎了。

examples.en: He found a shred of paper in his pocket.
examples.zh: 他在口袋裡發現一小片碎紙。

examples.en: There is not a shred of evidence to support the story.
examples.zh: 沒有任何證據能支持這個說法。

examples.en: Only a few shreds of cloth were left on the tree.
examples.zh: 樹上只剩幾片碎布。

examples.en: The children shrieked with joy on the water slide.
examples.zh: 孩子們在滑水道上開心地尖叫。

examples.en: She shrieked when she saw a spider in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 她在浴室看到蜘蛛時尖叫起來。

examples.en: The brakes shrieked as the bus stopped suddenly.
examples.zh: 公車突然停下時，煞車發出刺耳的尖響。

examples.en: A shriek came from the kitchen when someone spotted a mouse.
examples.zh: 有人發現老鼠時，廚房傳來一聲尖叫。

examples.en: We heard a shriek of laughter from the playground.
examples.zh: 我們聽到操場傳來一陣尖笑聲。

examples.en: The shriek of the alarm woke everyone up.
examples.zh: 警報的尖銳聲吵醒了所有人。

examples.en: A small shrub grows by the front gate of our house.
examples.zh: 我們家前門旁長了一叢小灌木。

examples.en: Gardeners cut the shrubs into the shape of animals.
examples.zh: 園丁把灌木修剪成動物的形狀。

examples.en: Birds built a nest in the thick shrub behind the school.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在學校後面茂密的灌木叢裡築了巢。

senses.zh: 洗牌；拖著腳走；隨機播放

examples.en: Can you shuffle the cards before we start the game?
examples.zh: 開始遊戲之前，你可以先洗牌嗎？

examples.en: The old man shuffled slowly across the room.
examples.zh: 老先生拖著腳慢慢走過房間。

examples.en: Press this button to shuffle the songs on your playlist.
examples.zh: 按這個按鈕就能隨機播放播放清單裡的歌。

examples.en: She closed the shutters to keep the afternoon sun out.
examples.zh: 她關上遮窗板，擋住午後的陽光。

examples.en: Press the shutter button to take a photo.
examples.zh: 按下快門鈕就能拍照。

examples.en: The old house had green wooden shutters on every window.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的每扇窗戶都裝有綠色的木製遮窗板。

examples.en: I like the simplicity of this recipe.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這份食譜，因為做法簡單。

examples.en: The simplicity of the design makes the phone easy to use.
examples.zh: 這個設計的簡潔讓這支手機很好用。

examples.en: They chose a life of simplicity in a small town.
examples.zh: 他們選擇在小鎮過簡樸的生活。

examples.en: The conference offers simultaneous translation in three languages.
examples.zh: 這場會議提供三種語言的同步口譯。

examples.en: There were two simultaneous events in the school hall.
examples.zh: 學校禮堂裡同時舉行兩場活動。

examples.en: The simultaneous arrival of two buses blocked the road.
examples.zh: 兩輛公車同時抵達，擋住了道路。

examples.en: I am skeptical about advertisements that promise quick results.
examples.zh: 我對承諾快速見效的廣告抱持懷疑。

examples.en: The teacher was skeptical of his excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 老師對他遲到的藉口半信半疑。

examples.en: Many scientists remain skeptical about the new treatment.
examples.zh: 許多科學家對這種新療法仍然存疑。

examples.en: The store will slash prices during the anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 這家店在週年慶期間將大幅砍價。

examples.en: The company decided to slash its advertising budget.
examples.zh: 公司決定大幅削減廣告預算。

examples.en: A sharp branch slashed his jacket as he walked through the woods.
examples.zh: 他穿越樹林時，一根尖銳的樹枝劃破了他的外套。

examples.en: Type a slash between the day and the month.
examples.zh: 在日和月之間輸入一個斜線。

examples.en: The tailor repaired the slash in my jacket with matching thread.
examples.zh: 裁縫用同色的線修補了我外套上的割口。

examples.en: The web address has a slash after the name.
examples.zh: 這個網址在名稱後面有一個斜線。

examples.en: Strict laws control the slaughter of farm animals.
examples.zh: 嚴格的法律管制農場動物的屠宰。

examples.en: Our team lost ten to zero; it was a complete slaughter.
examples.zh: 我們隊以十比零落敗，簡直是慘敗。

examples.en: Debate over the slaughter of animals for food continues in many countries.
examples.zh: 關於為了食用而屠宰動物的爭論，在許多國家仍持續著。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, the knight must slay a dragon.
examples.zh: 在童話故事裡，騎士必須殺死一條龍。

examples.en: My sister slayed her dance performance at the school talent show.
examples.zh: 我妹妹在學校才藝表演中的舞蹈演出精彩極了。

examples.en: The hero in the game must slay the monster to win.
examples.zh: 遊戲中的主角必須擊殺怪物才能獲勝。

examples.en: Your sloppy handwriting is hard to read.
examples.zh: 你潦草的字跡很難辨認。

examples.en: He wore a sloppy sweater with holes in it.
examples.zh: 他穿著一件有破洞的邋遢毛衣。

examples.en: Sloppy mistakes in the report made the manager angry.
examples.zh: 報告中因馬虎造成的錯誤讓經理生氣了。

examples.en: Many families in the slum have no clean water.
examples.zh: 貧民窟裡的許多家庭沒有乾淨的水。

examples.en: The charity built a school in a slum near the capital.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構在首都附近的貧民窟蓋了一所學校。

examples.en: She grew up in a slum but became a doctor.
examples.zh: 她在貧民窟長大，後來成為醫師。

examples.en: The company is in a slump after losing its main customer.
examples.zh: 公司失去主要客戶後陷入低迷。

examples.en: Sales fell sharply during the summer slump.
examples.zh: 夏季的不景氣使銷售量大幅下滑。

examples.en: The team's slump lasted for six games.
examples.zh: 球隊的低潮持續了六場比賽。

examples.en: The tired boy slumped into his chair after school.
examples.zh: 疲倦的男孩放學後癱坐在椅子上。

examples.en: Stock prices slumped after the bad news.
examples.zh: 壞消息傳出後，股價暴跌。

examples.en: He slumped over his desk and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 他無力地趴在書桌上睡著了。

examples.en: The fox in the story was sly and clever.
examples.zh: 故事裡的狐狸既狡猾又聰明。

examples.en: She gave me a sly smile when I asked about the surprise.
examples.zh: 我問起驚喜時，她對我露出狡黠的微笑。

examples.en: He used a sly trick to win the board game.
examples.zh: 他耍了個小手段，贏得了這場桌遊。

examples.en: My dad snores so loudly that I can hear him next door.
examples.zh: 我爸爸打鼾打得很大聲，我在隔壁都聽得到。

examples.en: Dogs sometimes snore in their sleep, just as people do.
examples.zh: 狗有時也會像人一樣在睡夢中打鼾。

examples.en: He snored through the whole movie and missed the exciting ending.
examples.zh: 他整部電影都在打鼾，錯過了精彩的結局。

examples.en: I heard a loud snore from the sofa.
examples.zh: 我聽到沙發傳來很大的鼾聲。

examples.en: His snore kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 他的鼾聲讓我整晚睡不著。

examples.en: A soft snore came from the baby's room.
examples.zh: 嬰兒房傳來輕輕的鼾聲。

examples.en: Our teacher explained the history of socialism in Europe.
examples.zh: 老師說明了社會主義在歐洲的歷史。

examples.en: Some economists compare capitalism and socialism in class.
examples.zh: 有些經濟學家在課堂上比較資本主義與社會主義。

examples.en: The book explains how socialism began in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這本書說明社會主義如何在十九世紀興起。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about socialist ideas in the 1900s.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個介紹一九〇〇年代社會主義思想的展覽。

examples.en: The textbook describes the socialist movement of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 課本描述了十九世紀的社會主義運動。

examples.en: Some countries once had socialist economic systems.
examples.zh: 有些國家曾經實行社會主義的經濟體制。

examples.en: The author was a socialist who wrote about workers' rights.
examples.zh: 這位作家是位社會主義者，寫過關於勞工權益的文章。

examples.en: The history teacher explained what a socialist believes.
examples.zh: 歷史老師解釋了社會主義者的信念。

examples.en: A socialist gave a talk at the university.
examples.zh: 一位社會主義者在大學裡演講。

examples.en: Teenagers like to socialize with friends after school.
examples.zh: 青少年喜歡放學後和朋友社交。

examples.en: The party gave coworkers a chance to socialize.
examples.zh: 這場派對讓同事有機會互相交際。

examples.en: It is important for puppies to socialize with other dogs.
examples.zh: 小狗和其他狗社交是很重要的。

examples.en: My sister is studying sociology at university.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在大學修讀社會學。

examples.en: Sociology looks at how groups of people behave.
examples.zh: 社會學研究人群的行為方式。

examples.en: The sociology class discussed changes in family life.
examples.zh: 社會學課討論了家庭生活的變化。

examples.en: The principal gave a solemn speech at the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了莊嚴的演說。

examples.en: He made a solemn promise to take care of his younger sister.
examples.zh: 他鄭重承諾會照顧妹妹。

examples.en: Everyone fell silent during the solemn ceremony.
examples.zh: 在這場莊嚴的儀式中，每個人都安靜下來。

examples.en: The students showed solidarity by working on the project together.
examples.zh: 學生們一起完成專題，展現了團結的精神。

examples.en: Workers across the country expressed solidarity with the strikers.
examples.zh: 全國各地的勞工表達了對罷工者的聲援。

examples.en: Our neighbors showed great solidarity after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，我們的鄰居展現了高度的團結。

examples.en: He enjoys long solitary walks along the river.
examples.zh: 他喜歡沿著河邊獨自長時間散步。

examples.en: A solitary tree stood on the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 一棵孤零零的樹立在山頂上。

examples.en: The old man lived a solitary life in the mountains.
examples.zh: 那位老先生在山裡過著獨居生活。

examples.en: She likes to enjoy solitude in her room after a busy day.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在忙碌的一天後待在房間裡獨處。

examples.en: The writer went to a cabin to find solitude.
examples.zh: 這位作家前往小木屋尋求獨處的時光。

examples.en: There is peace and solitude in the countryside.
examples.zh: 在鄉間可以享受平靜與獨處。

examples.en: The mother sang softly to soothe her crying baby.
examples.zh: 母親輕聲唱歌來安撫哭鬧的寶寶。

examples.en: A warm cup of tea can soothe a sore throat.
examples.zh: 一杯熱茶可以減輕喉嚨痛。

examples.en: Soft music helps soothe my nerves before an exam.
examples.zh: 輕柔的音樂能在考試前舒緩我的緊張情緒。

examples.en: The girl gave a sorrowful look when she lost her pet.
examples.zh: 女孩失去寵物時露出悲傷的神情。

examples.en: They sang a sorrowful song at the funeral.
examples.zh: 他們在葬禮上唱了一首哀傷的歌。

examples.en: His sorrowful voice told us the bad news.
examples.zh: 他憂傷的聲音讓我們知道了壞消息。

examples.en: Japan is a sovereign country located in East Asia.
examples.zh: 日本是位於東亞的主權國家。

examples.en: Every sovereign nation has the right to make its own laws.
examples.zh: 每個主權國家都有權制定自己的法律。

examples.en: The island became a sovereign state after the agreement.
examples.zh: 協議簽訂後，這座島成為了獨立自主的國家。

examples.en: The sovereign gave a speech to the people.
examples.zh: 君主向人民發表談話。

examples.en: The old sovereign ruled the land for fifty years.
examples.zh: 這位老君主統治這片土地五十年。

examples.en: A sovereign usually lives in a large palace.
examples.zh: 君主通常住在一座大宮殿裡。

examples.en: The bridge has a span of two hundred meters.
examples.zh: 這座橋的跨度是兩百公尺。

examples.en: A child's attention span is usually quite short.
examples.zh: 孩子的注意力持續時間通常很短。

examples.en: Over a span of ten years, the town changed a lot.
examples.zh: 在十年的期間裡，這個小鎮改變了很多。

examples.en: A long bridge spans the wide river.
examples.zh: 一座長橋橫跨寬闊的河流。

examples.en: Her career spans more than thirty years.
examples.zh: 她的職涯長達三十多年。

examples.en: The museum's collection spans many centuries, from ancient pottery to modern paintings.
examples.zh: 這間博物館的收藏涵蓋多個世紀，從古代陶器到現代畫作都有。

examples.en: The fireworks made a beautiful spectacle over the harbor.
examples.zh: 煙火在港口上空形成了美麗的壯觀景象。

examples.en: The parade was a colorful spectacle for the children.
examples.zh: 這場遊行對孩子們來說是色彩繽紛的奇觀。

examples.en: He put on his spectacles to read the small print.
examples.zh: 他戴上眼鏡來閱讀小字。

examples.en: A spiral of smoke rose from the chimney.
examples.zh: 一道螺旋狀的煙從煙囪升起。

examples.en: The shell has a beautiful spiral on its surface.
examples.zh: 這個貝殼的表面有漂亮的螺旋紋。

examples.en: Rising prices pushed the family into a spiral of debt.
examples.zh: 物價上漲讓這家人陷入債務的惡性循環。

examples.en: The leaf spiraled slowly down to the ground.
examples.zh: 那片葉子慢慢盤旋落到地上。

examples.en: The kite spiraled up into the sky.
examples.zh: 風箏盤旋著飛上天空。

examples.en: Prices began to spiral out of control last year.
examples.zh: 去年物價開始失控飆升。

examples.en: Tourists admired the splendor of the old palace.
examples.zh: 遊客讚嘆這座古老宮殿的壯麗。

examples.en: The splendor of the sunset made everyone stop and look.
examples.zh: 夕陽的壯麗讓每個人都停下來欣賞。

examples.en: The hotel lobby was decorated with great splendor.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的大廳裝飾得十分華麗。

senses.zh: 自發的；臨時起意的；不做作的

examples.en: The crowd gave the team a spontaneous round of applause.
examples.zh: 群眾自發地為球隊鼓掌。

examples.en: We took a spontaneous trip to the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末我們臨時起意去了海邊旅行。

examples.en: Her spontaneous laughter made everyone smile during the tense meeting.
examples.zh: 在氣氛緊張的會議中，她自然流露的笑聲讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: The singer stood in the spotlight at the center of the stage.
examples.zh: 歌手站在舞台中央的聚光燈下。

examples.en: The young actor was suddenly in the spotlight after the movie came out.
examples.zh: 電影上映後，這位年輕演員突然成為眾人矚目的焦點。

examples.en: The news put a spotlight on air pollution in the city.
examples.zh: 這則新聞讓這座城市的空氣污染成為關注焦點。

examples.en: The article spotlights several young teachers in the school.
examples.zh: 這篇文章聚焦於學校裡幾位年輕的老師。

examples.en: The festival will spotlight local artists this year.
examples.zh: 今年的藝術節將突顯在地的藝術家。

examples.en: The report spotlighted the need for safer roads.
examples.zh: 這份報告突顯了改善道路安全的必要性。

examples.en: The coach's words spurred the team to play harder.
examples.zh: 教練的話激勵球隊更加努力比賽。

examples.en: Lower prices may spur more people to buy electric cars.
examples.zh: 降低價格也許能促使更多人購買電動車。

examples.en: His success spurred her to work harder.
examples.zh: 他的成功激勵她更努力工作。

examples.en: The prize was a spur for the students to study harder.
examples.zh: 這個獎項成為激勵學生更用功的動力。

examples.en: The cowboy wore a pair of spurs on his boots.
examples.zh: 那位牛仔的靴子上裝了一對馬刺。

examples.en: The new law was a spur to local business.
examples.zh: 這項新法規對本地商業是一種刺激。

examples.en: The doctor gave the patient medicine to stabilize his heartbeat.
examples.zh: 醫生給病人用藥來穩定他的心跳。

examples.en: The government is trying to stabilize the price of rice.
examples.zh: 政府正努力穩定米價。

examples.en: We put a book under the table leg to stabilize it.
examples.zh: 我們在桌腳下墊了一本書讓它穩固。

senses.zh: 搖搖晃晃地走；錯開；使震驚

examples.en: The tired runner staggered across the finish line.
examples.zh: 疲憊的跑者搖搖晃晃地跨過終點線。

examples.en: The company will stagger working hours to avoid traffic jams.
examples.zh: 公司會讓上班時間錯開以避免塞車。

examples.en: The unexpected cost of repairing the roof staggered the homeowner.
examples.zh: 修屋頂的意外費用讓屋主大吃一驚。

examples.en: Rice is the staple of many Asian countries.
examples.zh: 米飯是許多亞洲國家的主食。

examples.en: Please put a staple in the top corner of the report.
examples.zh: 請在報告上方的一角釘上一根釘書針。

examples.en: Milk and eggs are staples in our kitchen.
examples.zh: 牛奶和雞蛋是我們廚房裡的必備品。

examples.en: Bread is the staple food in many countries.
examples.zh: 麵包是許多國家的主食。

examples.en: Rice is a staple crop in this region.
examples.zh: 稻米是這個地區的主要作物。

examples.en: Noodles are a staple part of the local diet.
examples.zh: 麵食是當地飲食的主要部分。

examples.en: Please staple the pages together before you hand them in.
examples.zh: 交出去之前，請把這幾頁釘在一起。

examples.en: She stapled the receipt to the form.
examples.zh: 她把收據釘在表格上。

examples.en: I need to staple these documents for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我得把這些文件釘好給會議使用。

examples.en: The old statesman was respected by people from all parties.
examples.zh: 這位老政治家受到各黨派人士的尊敬。

examples.en: The statesman gave a speech about peace at the conference.
examples.zh: 這位政治家在會議上發表了關於和平的演說。

examples.en: Many students read about the great statesman in history class.
examples.zh: 許多學生在歷史課上讀到這位偉大的政治家。

examples.en: The car was stationary at the red light.
examples.zh: 那輛車在紅燈前靜止不動。

examples.en: Please stay seated until the train is stationary.
examples.zh: 請在火車完全靜止前坐在座位上。

examples.en: A stationary bike is a good way to exercise at home.
examples.zh: 固定式健身車是在家運動的好方法。

examples.en: The boy is small in stature but very good at basketball.
examples.zh: 這個男孩身材矮小，但很會打籃球。

examples.en: The scientist is a person of great stature in the field.
examples.zh: 這位科學家在該領域享有崇高的聲望。

examples.en: His kindness raised his stature among the neighbors.
examples.zh: 他的善良提高了他在鄰居間的地位。

examples.en: He treats his stepchild as warmly as his own son.
examples.zh: 他對待配偶的孩子，就像對待自己的兒子一樣親切。

examples.en: The stepchild called her new father by his first name.
examples.zh: 那個繼女直呼她新爸爸的名字。

examples.en: A stepchild may need time to feel at home in a new family.
examples.zh: 繼子女可能需要時間才能在新家庭中感到自在。

examples.en: Babies need stimulation from toys and music to learn.
examples.zh: 嬰兒需要玩具和音樂的刺激來學習。

examples.en: Reading gives the brain good mental stimulation.
examples.zh: 閱讀能給大腦良好的心智刺激。

examples.en: Some children get little stimulation at home.
examples.zh: 有些孩子在家裡得到的刺激很少。

examples.en: Ships pass through the narrow strait every day.
examples.zh: 每天都有船隻穿過這條狹窄的海峽。

examples.en: The Taiwan Strait lies between Taiwan and mainland China.
examples.zh: 台灣海峽位於台灣與中國大陸之間。

examples.en: Many families were in financial straits after the local factory closed.
examples.zh: 當地工廠關閉後，許多家庭陷入財務困境。

examples.en: The weeds began to strangle the young plants in the garden.
examples.zh: 雜草開始嚴重阻礙花園裡幼苗的生長。

examples.en: This tight collar feels as if it might strangle me.
examples.zh: 這個緊繃的衣領讓我覺得快喘不過氣來。

examples.en: Too many rules can strangle new ideas.
examples.zh: 過多的規定可能扼殺新的想法。

examples.en: A stray dog followed us all the way home.
examples.zh: 一隻流浪狗一路跟著我們回家。

examples.en: We gave the stray cat some food and water.
examples.zh: 我們給了那隻流浪貓一些食物和水。

examples.en: A stray ball flew into our yard.
examples.zh: 一顆偏離目標的球飛進了我們的院子。

examples.en: Don't let the children stray too far from the camp.
examples.zh: 別讓孩子們離營地太遠。

examples.en: The speaker strayed from the topic during the talk.
examples.zh: 講者在演講中偏離了主題。

examples.en: My little brother strayed away from us in the market.
examples.zh: 我弟弟在市場裡走失了。

examples.en: He crossed the room in three long strides.
examples.zh: 他三大步就走過了房間。

examples.en: She kept her stride steady during the marathon.
examples.zh: 她在馬拉松中保持穩定的步伐。

examples.en: The school has made great strides in teaching English.
examples.zh: 這所學校在英語教學上有了很大的進步。

examples.en: The teacher strode into the classroom with a smile.
examples.zh: 老師面帶微笑大步走進教室。

examples.en: He strode up to the counter and asked for a ticket.
examples.zh: 他大步走到櫃檯要了一張票。

examples.en: The manager strode across the lobby to meet us.
examples.zh: 經理大步穿過大廳來迎接我們。

examples.en: We like to stroll along the beach after dinner.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡晚餐後沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: Tourists strolled through the old street with their cameras.
examples.zh: 遊客們帶著相機在老街上閒逛。

examples.en: She strolled around the park while waiting for her friend.
examples.zh: 她等朋友時在公園裡閒逛。

examples.en: Grandpa takes a stroll in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 爺爺每天早上都會在公園裡散步。
