examples.en: The hotel is a short stroll from the night market.
examples.zh: 這間飯店離夜市只有一小段散步的路程。

examples.en: We went for a stroll by the lake.
examples.zh: 我們去湖邊散了個步。

examples.en: The sudden news stunned the whole class.
examples.zh: 這個突如其來的消息讓全班震驚。

examples.en: Her beautiful voice stunned the judges at the school singing contest.
examples.zh: 她美妙的歌聲在學校歌唱比賽中讓評審們驚豔不已。

examples.en: The loud noise nearly stunned the little bird.
examples.zh: 那巨大的聲響差點讓那隻小鳥昏過去。

examples.en: He stuttered when he was nervous in front of the class.
examples.zh: 他在全班面前緊張時會結巴。

examples.en: She stuttered a few words and then stopped.
examples.zh: 她結結巴巴地說了幾個字就停下來了。

examples.en: The boy stuttered an apology to his teacher.
examples.zh: 男孩結結巴巴地向老師道歉。

examples.en: He has had a stutter since he was a child.
examples.zh: 他從小就有口吃。

examples.en: The actor worked hard to overcome his stutter.
examples.zh: 這位演員努力克服他的口吃。

examples.en: You could hear a slight stutter in her voice.
examples.zh: 你可以聽出她的聲音有些結巴。

examples.en: She wore a stylish coat to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件時髦的外套去參加派對。

examples.en: This café has a stylish design with wooden tables.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡店設計時尚，配有木桌。

examples.en: My uncle drives a stylish little car.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開著一輛有型的小車。

examples.en: Taste in music is subjective, so friends may prefer different styles.
examples.zh: 音樂品味是主觀的，所以朋友之間可能偏好不同風格。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to avoid subjective opinions in the report.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們在報告中避免主觀的意見。

examples.en: Beauty is a subjective idea that differs from person to person.
examples.zh: 美是一種因人而異的主觀想法。

examples.en: Safety should never be subordinate to speed.
examples.zh: 安全絕不該屈居於速度之後。

examples.en: He holds a subordinate position in the company.
examples.zh: 他在公司裡擔任下級職務。

examples.en: The report was written by a subordinate officer.
examples.zh: 這份報告是由一位下級官員撰寫的。

examples.en: A good manager listens to her subordinates.
examples.zh: 好的主管會傾聽部屬的意見。

examples.en: He treats his subordinates with respect, even when they make mistakes.
examples.zh: 即使自己的部屬犯錯，他也會尊重他們。

examples.en: The boss thanked his subordinates for their hard work.
examples.zh: 老闆感謝部屬們的辛勤工作。

examples.en: I subscribe to a weekly English magazine.
examples.zh: 我訂閱了一份英文週刊。

examples.en: Please subscribe to our channel for more videos.
examples.zh: 請訂閱我們的頻道以觀看更多影片。

examples.en: I do not subscribe to the view that money guarantees happiness.
examples.zh: 我不贊同金錢能保證幸福的看法。

examples.en: My monthly subscription to the online magazine costs ten dollars.
examples.zh: 我的線上雜誌訂閱費每月是十美元。

examples.en: You can cancel your subscription at any time.
examples.zh: 你可以隨時取消訂閱。

examples.en: A one-year subscription includes twelve issues of the magazine.
examples.zh: 一年的訂閱包含十二期雜誌。

examples.en: The government subsidizes lunches for students in need.
examples.zh: 政府補助有需要的學生的午餐。

examples.en: The city subsidizes public transportation for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 這座城市補助長者搭乘大眾運輸。

examples.en: The company subsidized part of the employees' English classes.
examples.zh: 公司補助員工部分英語課程費用。

examples.en: We had a succession of rainy days last week.
examples.zh: 上週我們這裡連續下了好幾天雨。

examples.en: The prince is next in succession to the throne.
examples.zh: 王子是王位的下一位繼承人。

examples.en: The company planned the succession of its new manager carefully.
examples.zh: 公司仔細規劃新經理的接班事宜。

examples.en: The team won three successive games this month.
examples.zh: 這支球隊這個月連贏三場比賽。

examples.en: It rained for four successive days, forcing us to cancel the camping trip.
examples.zh: 連續下了四天雨，迫使我們取消露營行程。

examples.en: She won the speech contest for the second successive year.
examples.zh: 她連續第二年贏得演講比賽。

examples.en: The thick smoke nearly suffocated the people in the room.
examples.zh: 濃煙差點讓房間裡的人窒息。

examples.en: I felt like I was suffocating in the crowded elevator.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的電梯裡，我覺得快要喘不過氣。

examples.en: Keep plastic bags away from babies so they cannot suffocate.
examples.zh: 請讓塑膠袋遠離嬰兒，以免他們窒息。

examples.en: The principal summoned the students to his office.
examples.zh: 校長把學生召喚到他的辦公室。

examples.en: The manager summoned all the staff to an emergency meeting.
examples.zh: 經理召集所有員工參加緊急會議。

examples.en: She summoned her courage and spoke in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她鼓起勇氣在全班面前發言。

examples.en: The cut on his finger was only superficial.
examples.zh: 他手指上的傷口只是皮肉傷。

examples.en: She has only a superficial knowledge of the subject.
examples.zh: 她對這個主題只有膚淺的認識。

examples.en: The two brothers look alike but have only superficial similarities.
examples.zh: 這對兄弟長得像，但只有表面上的相似。

examples.en: The school superintendent visited our class yesterday.
examples.zh: 學區總監昨天來參訪我們班。

examples.en: The building superintendent fixed the broken light in the hall.
examples.zh: 大樓管理員修好了走廊壞掉的燈。

examples.en: The superintendent announced a new plan for the school district.
examples.zh: 這位總監宣布了一項學區的新計畫。

examples.en: The team showed its superiority by winning every game.
examples.zh: 這支球隊靠贏下每一場比賽展現了優勢。

examples.en: He spoke with an air of superiority that annoyed his classmates.
examples.zh: 他說話帶著優越感，讓同學們很不舒服。

examples.en: The superiority of this phone lies in its battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機的優勢在於電池續航力。

examples.en: My grandmother is superstitious about the number four.
examples.zh: 我奶奶對數字四很迷信。

examples.en: Some superstitious people think black cats bring bad luck.
examples.zh: 有些迷信的人認為黑貓會帶來厄運。

examples.en: The player is superstitious and always wears the same socks.
examples.zh: 這位球員很迷信，總是穿同一雙襪子。

examples.en: She takes a vitamin supplement every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都吃維他命補充劑。

examples.en: The newspaper comes with a weekend supplement.
examples.zh: 這份報紙附有週末增刊。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a supplement to the textbook.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份課本的補充教材。

examples.en: He works part-time to supplement his income.
examples.zh: 他兼差來補貼收入。

examples.en: You can supplement your diet with more fruit.
examples.zh: 你可以在飲食中增加水果。

examples.en: Students may supplement the lesson with online videos.
examples.zh: 學生可以用線上影片來補充課程。

examples.en: The company tried to suppress evidence of problems with its products.
examples.zh: 這家公司試圖隱瞞產品有問題的證據。

examples.en: He tried to suppress a laugh during the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講時試圖忍住不笑出來。

examples.en: This medicine can suppress a cough for several hours.
examples.zh: 這種藥可以抑制咳嗽好幾個小時。

senses.zh: 激增；情緒湧現；電力突波

examples.en: There was a surge in online shopping during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期期間網路購物量激增。

examples.en: She felt a surge of joy when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息時，她心中湧起一陣喜悅。

examples.en: A power surge damaged the old computer.
examples.zh: 電流突波損壞了那台舊電腦。

examples.en: The crowd surged toward the stage when the singer appeared.
examples.zh: 歌手出現時，群眾湧向舞台。

examples.en: Food prices surged after the storm damaged roads and delayed deliveries.
examples.zh: 暴風雨損壞道路、延誤運送後，食品價格飆漲。

examples.en: Water surged into the street after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，水湧上了街道。

examples.en: The nurse handed the doctor a surgical tool.
examples.zh: 護理師遞給醫生一把手術器械。

examples.en: All surgical masks must be thrown away after use.
examples.zh: 所有外科口罩使用後都必須丟棄。

examples.en: He needs a surgical operation on his knee.
examples.zh: 他的膝蓋需要動手術。

examples.en: Her test score surpassed everyone's expectations after months of steady practice.
examples.zh: 經過數月持續練習後，她的考試成績超出了所有人的預期。

examples.en: The new phone surpasses the old one in speed.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的速度勝過舊的那支。

examples.en: Sales this year have surpassed last year's record.
examples.zh: 今年的銷售量已經超越去年的紀錄。

examples.en: The movie is full of suspense from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 這部電影從頭到尾都充滿懸疑。

examples.en: Don't keep us in suspense; tell us the result.
examples.zh: 別讓我們懸著心，快告訴我們結果。

examples.en: The suspense grew as the judges opened the envelope.
examples.zh: 評審打開信封時，緊張的氣氛越來越濃。

examples.en: Frogs and snakes live in the swamp near our village.
examples.zh: 青蛙和蛇住在我們村子附近的沼澤裡。

examples.en: The farmer turned the swamp into a rice field.
examples.zh: 農夫把沼澤變成了稻田。

examples.en: It is hard to walk through the swamp after rain.
examples.zh: 下雨後很難走過那片沼澤。

examples.en: The heavy rain swamped the small boat.
examples.zh: 大雨使那艘小船被水淹沒。

examples.en: The store was swamped with customers on sale day.
examples.zh: 特價那天，店裡擠滿了顧客，忙得不可開交。

examples.en: I am swamped with homework this week.
examples.zh: 這週我被功課壓得喘不過氣。

examples.en: A swarm of bees settled on the old apple tree.
examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂停在那棵老蘋果樹上。

examples.en: We ran away from the swarm of mosquitoes near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們跑開了湖邊那一大群蚊子。

examples.en: A swarm of fans waited outside the hotel for the singer.
examples.zh: 一大群粉絲在飯店外等著那位歌手。

examples.en: Tourists swarm into the night market every weekend.
examples.zh: 每逢週末，遊客都會成群湧入夜市。

examples.en: Children swarmed around the ice cream truck.
examples.zh: 孩子們紛紛擠到冰淇淋車旁。

examples.en: Shoppers swarm the department store during the sale.
examples.zh: 特價期間，購物的人潮擠滿了百貨公司。

examples.en: The butterfly's wings show perfect symmetry in their colorful patterns.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀上繽紛的圖案呈現完美的對稱。

examples.en: Our art teacher talked about symmetry in design.
examples.zh: 我們的美術老師談到設計中的對稱。

examples.en: The symmetry of the building makes it look elegant.
examples.zh: 這棟建築的對稱設計使它看起來很優雅。

examples.en: A synonym for the word big is huge.
examples.zh: big 這個字的同義字是 huge。

examples.en: Can you think of a synonym for the word happy?
examples.zh: 你想得出 happy 這個字的近義詞嗎？

examples.en: I use a dictionary to find a synonym when I write essays.
examples.zh: 我寫作文時會用字典找近義詞。

examples.en: This jacket is made of synthetic fiber.
examples.zh: 這件外套是用合成纖維做的。

examples.en: Synthetic leather is cheaper than real leather.
examples.zh: 人造皮比真皮便宜。

examples.en: The factory produces synthetic materials for sports shoes.
examples.zh: 這家工廠生產運動鞋用的合成材料。

examples.en: She came back from the beach with a nice tan.
examples.zh: 她從海邊回來時，曬出了一身漂亮的棕褐膚色。

examples.en: My new boots are a light tan.
examples.zh: 我的新靴子是淺棕褐色。

examples.en: He tried to get a tan during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他在暑假期間想把皮膚曬黑。

examples.en: My skin tans easily in the sun.
examples.zh: 我的皮膚在太陽下很容易曬黑。

examples.en: She likes to tan by the pool.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在泳池邊把皮膚曬黑。

examples.en: We tanned quickly during our trip to Okinawa.
examples.zh: 我們去沖繩旅行時很快就曬黑了。

examples.en: Copying all these numbers by hand is a tedious job.
examples.zh: 用手抄寫這些數字是件乏味的工作。

examples.en: The meeting was long and tedious, with little useful discussion.
examples.zh: 這場會議冗長又乏味，幾乎沒有什麼有用的討論。

examples.en: Washing dishes can be tedious, but someone has to do it.
examples.zh: 洗碗可能很乏味，但總得有人來做。

examples.en: The teller counted the money twice before handing it to me.
examples.zh: 行員把錢數了兩次才交給我。

examples.en: I asked the bank teller how to open a new account.
examples.zh: 我問銀行行員要怎麼開新帳戶。

examples.en: A friendly teller helped my grandfather with the form.
examples.zh: 一位親切的行員幫我爺爺填寫表格。

examples.en: The band slowly increased the tempo of the song.
examples.zh: 樂團慢慢加快了這首歌的速度。

examples.en: Our piano teacher asked us to keep a steady tempo.
examples.zh: 我們的鋼琴老師要求我們保持穩定的演奏速度。

examples.en: The tempo of city life is much faster than in the countryside.
examples.zh: 都市生活的步調比鄉下快得多。

examples.en: We made a tentative plan to visit Tainan next month.
examples.zh: 我們暫定下個月去台南玩。

examples.en: The two teams reached a tentative agreement.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍達成了一項暫定協議。

examples.en: She gave a tentative smile before answering the question.
examples.zh: 她回答問題前先露出了猶豫的微笑。

examples.en: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 我們在可以俯瞰大海的露台上吃早餐。

examples.en: The restaurant has a terrace with a nice view.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳有一個景觀很棒的露台。

examples.en: Farmers grow tea on terraces along the mountainside.
examples.zh: 農夫在山坡的梯田上種茶。

examples.en: The country is famous for its colorful textiles.
examples.zh: 這個國家以色彩繽紛的紡織品聞名。

examples.en: My aunt works in a textile factory.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在紡織工廠工作。

examples.en: The museum has a display of old textiles from Asia.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了一批來自亞洲的古老織品。

examples.en: The textile industry once employed thousands of workers here.
examples.zh: 紡織業曾在這裡僱用了數千名工人。

examples.en: He studies textile design at university and hopes to create new fabrics.
examples.zh: 他在大學讀紡織設計，希望能創造新的布料。

examples.en: The company sells textile products around the world.
examples.zh: 這家公司把紡織產品賣到世界各地。

examples.en: She moved to Taipei in 2015 and worked there thereafter.
examples.zh: 她在二〇一五年搬到台北，此後一直在那裡工作。

examples.en: The store opens at nine, and shortly thereafter the customers arrive.
examples.zh: 商店九點開門，不久之後顧客就來了。

examples.en: He broke his leg last year and rarely played sports thereafter.
examples.zh: 他去年摔斷了腿，此後就很少運動了。

examples.en: The nurse put a thermometer under my arm.
examples.zh: 護理師把體溫計夾在我的腋下。

examples.en: The thermometer shows that it is thirty degrees outside.
examples.zh: 溫度計顯示外面是三十度。

examples.en: Please check the thermometer before you open the window.
examples.zh: 開窗前請先看一下溫度計。

examples.en: She tilted her head and listened carefully.
examples.zh: 她歪著頭仔細聆聽。

examples.en: Do not tilt the cup, or the tea will spill.
examples.zh: 不要把杯子傾斜，不然茶會灑出來。

examples.en: The boat tilted to one side in the strong wind.
examples.zh: 船在強風中向一側傾斜。

examples.en: The picture on the wall has a slight tilt.
examples.zh: 牆上的畫有一點歪。

examples.en: A slight tilt of the bottle helped the last drops of water flow out.
examples.zh: 稍微傾斜瓶子，就讓最後幾滴水流了出來。

examples.en: The tilt of the table made the pens roll away.
examples.zh: 桌子的傾斜讓筆都滾走了。

examples.en: You need a token to ride this machine at the arcade.
examples.zh: 你需要一枚代幣才能玩遊樂場裡的這台機器。

examples.en: He gave her a small gift as a token of thanks.
examples.zh: 他送她一份小禮物表示感謝。

examples.en: The shop gave me a gift token for my birthday.
examples.zh: 這家店在我生日時送了我一張禮券。

examples.en: They paid a token fee to use the room.
examples.zh: 他們付了象徵性的費用來使用這個房間。

examples.en: The company made only a token effort to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 公司只是象徵性地努力了一下要解決問題。

examples.en: We charged a token price for the old books.
examples.zh: 我們以象徵性的價格賣出了那些舊書。

examples.en: The rain turned the small stream into a torrent.
examples.zh: 大雨使小溪變成了急流。

examples.en: A torrent of water rushed down the mountain road.
examples.zh: 一股急流沿著山路衝了下來。

examples.en: She received a torrent of messages after the news came out.
examples.zh: 消息公布後，她收到了大量的訊息。

examples.en: I need to send my school transcript to the university.
examples.zh: 我需要把學校成績單寄給那所大學。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a transcript of the speech.
examples.zh: 老師發給我們那場演講的逐字稿。

examples.en: You can request an official transcript at the registrar's office.
examples.zh: 你可以到註冊組申請正式的成績單。

examples.en: The station will transmit the game live tonight.
examples.zh: 電視台今晚將現場轉播這場比賽。

examples.en: Mosquitoes can transmit diseases to people through their bites.
examples.zh: 蚊子會透過叮咬把疾病傳染給人。

examples.en: This cable transmits data at very high speed.
examples.zh: 這條線路以很高的速度傳輸資料。

examples.en: The government paid for the new bridge from the national treasury.
examples.zh: 政府從國庫撥款支付新橋的建造費用。

examples.en: The minister of the treasury spoke on the news yesterday.
examples.zh: 財政部長昨天在新聞中發言。

examples.en: This old library is a treasury of rare books.
examples.zh: 這間老圖書館是珍本書籍的寶庫。

examples.en: We took a long trek through the mountains last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我們在山裡長途健行。

examples.en: The trek to the campsite took us five hours.
examples.zh: 走到露營地花了我們五個小時。

examples.en: It was a tiring trek, but the view was worth it.
examples.zh: 雖然這趟跋涉很累，但看到這片景色就值得了。

examples.en: They trekked across the hills with heavy backpacks.
examples.zh: 他們背著沉重的後背包徒步穿越山丘。

examples.en: We plan to trek in Nepal next year.
examples.zh: 我們打算明年去尼泊爾徒步旅行。

examples.en: The students trekked to the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 學生們一路走到山頂。

examples.en: Don't worry about such a trifle when we have bigger problems.
examples.zh: 我們還有更大的問題要處理，別為了這點小事煩惱。

examples.en: They argued over a trifle and then felt silly.
examples.zh: 他們為了一件小事吵了起來，後來覺得很傻。

examples.en: The tablet cost me only a trifle at the sale.
examples.zh: 這台平板在特價時只花了我一點點錢。

examples.en: You should not trifle with your health.
examples.zh: 你不該拿自己的健康開玩笑。

examples.en: Don't trifle with her feelings by making promises you cannot keep.
examples.zh: 不要許下做不到的承諾，隨意玩弄她的感情。

examples.en: He trifled with the pen while he was thinking.
examples.zh: 他邊思考邊把玩著手中的筆。

examples.en: The country's debt has reached a trillion dollars.
examples.zh: 這個國家的債務已經達到一兆美元。

examples.en: A trillion is a one followed by twelve zeros.
examples.zh: 一兆是一後面接十二個零。

examples.en: Scientists say there are trillions of stars in the universe.
examples.zh: 科學家說宇宙中有數以兆計的星星。

examples.en: Bananas grow well in the tropics, where the climate is warm.
examples.zh: 香蕉在氣候溫暖的熱帶地區生長得很好。

examples.en: The Tropic of Cancer passes through southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 北回歸線經過台灣南部。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the tropics to escape the cold winter.
examples.zh: 許多遊客為了躲避寒冬而前往熱帶地區。

examples.en: We caught a large trout in the mountain stream.
examples.zh: 我們在山間溪流裡釣到一條大鱒魚。

examples.en: The restaurant serves grilled trout with lemon.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應檸檬烤鱒魚。

examples.en: A trout swam under the little bridge.
examples.zh: 一條鱒魚從小橋下游過。

senses.zh: 受託管理人；非營利機構董事

examples.en: The school trustee spoke at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 學校的董事在開幕典禮上致詞。

examples.en: A trustee will take care of the money until he turns twenty.
examples.zh: 在他滿二十歲之前，會由一位受託人保管這筆錢。

examples.en: The trustees voted to build a new library.
examples.zh: 董事們投票決定興建一座新圖書館。

examples.en: Tuck your shirt into your pants before the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典禮前把襯衫紮進褲子裡。

examples.en: She tucked the letter into her bag.
examples.zh: 她把信塞進包包裡。

examples.en: Mom tucked the blanket around my brother.
examples.zh: 媽媽替弟弟把毯子裹好。

examples.en: The dress has a small tuck at the waist.
examples.zh: 這件洋裝的腰部有一個小褶。

examples.en: The tailor made a tuck in the sleeve.
examples.zh: 裁縫師在袖子上縫了一個褶。

examples.en: A tuck on the skirt makes it fit better.
examples.zh: 裙子上縫一個褶會更合身。

examples.en: The country was in turmoil after the sudden announcement.
examples.zh: 突如其來的公告讓這個國家陷入動盪。

examples.en: Her mind was in turmoil before the big exam.
examples.zh: 大考之前，她的心裡一片混亂。

examples.en: The company is in turmoil because its manager quit.
examples.zh: 因為經理離職，公司陷入一片混亂。

examples.en: We walked along the beach at twilight.
examples.zh: 我們在黃昏時沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: The sky turned purple in the twilight.
examples.zh: 暮色中，天空變成了紫色。

examples.en: Bats come out in the twilight to look for food.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在薄暮時分出來找食物。

examples.en: The class made a unanimous decision to hold the party.
examples.zh: 全班一致決定舉辦派對。

examples.en: The committee gave unanimous support to the new plan.
examples.zh: 委員會一致支持這項新計畫。

examples.en: The vote was unanimous, so we started right away.
examples.zh: 投票結果全體一致，所以我們馬上就開始了。

examples.en: Parents often give their children unconditional love, even when they make mistakes.
examples.zh: 即使孩子犯錯，父母也常給予他們無條件的愛。

examples.en: The school offered him an unconditional place in the program.
examples.zh: 學校無條件給了他這個課程的名額。

examples.en: We need your unconditional support for this project.
examples.zh: 這個專案需要你毫無保留的支持。

examples.en: Never underestimate the power of a good breakfast.
examples.zh: 千萬別低估一頓好早餐的力量。

examples.en: I underestimated how long the trip would take.
examples.zh: 我低估了這趟旅程需要的時間。

examples.en: Don't underestimate the difficulty of the final exam.
examples.zh: 不要低估期末考的難度。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping underneath the table.
examples.zh: 貓正睡在桌子底下。

examples.en: I found my keys underneath the sofa cushion.
examples.zh: 我在沙發墊下面找到了我的鑰匙。

examples.en: There is a small shop underneath our apartment.
examples.zh: 我們公寓樓下有一家小店。

examples.en: She wore a thin shirt with a warm sweater underneath.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件薄襯衫，裡面是暖和的毛衣。

examples.en: Lift the box and look underneath for the missing key.
examples.zh: 把箱子抬起來，看看那把遺失的鑰匙是否在下面。

examples.en: The painting was old, and a different picture was hidden underneath.
examples.zh: 這幅畫很老舊，底下藏著另一幅圖。

examples.en: The construction of the new bridge is already underway.
examples.zh: 新橋的工程已經開始進行了。

examples.en: Preparations for the school festival are underway.
examples.zh: 校慶的準備工作正在進行中。

examples.en: The meeting is underway, so please wait outside.
examples.zh: 會議正在進行中，請在外面等一下。

examples.en: The unification of the two companies took a year.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司的整合花了一年。

examples.en: They worked for the unification of the school clubs.
examples.zh: 他們努力促成學校社團的整合。

examples.en: Historians study the unification of several kingdoms into one country.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究數個王國統一為一個國家的過程。

examples.en: The new rules unify the work of all the departments.
examples.zh: 新規定統一了各部門的工作。

examples.en: A good leader can unify a team.
examples.zh: 好的領導者能讓團隊團結一心。

examples.en: The company wants to unify its websites into one.
examples.zh: 公司想把旗下的網站整合成一個。

examples.en: The company will unveil its new phone next week.
examples.zh: 公司將在下週發表新手機。

examples.en: The mayor unveiled a statue in the park.
examples.zh: 市長在公園為一座雕像揭幕。

examples.en: The museum plans to unveil a new painting on Friday.
examples.zh: 博物館打算在星期五首次公開展示一幅新畫作。

examples.en: Please keep your seat upright during takeoff.
examples.zh: 起飛時請把座椅椅背保持直立。

examples.en: He kept an upright posture while listening carefully to the speaker.
examples.zh: 他仔細聆聽講者時，保持挺直的姿勢。

examples.en: She is an upright person who always tells the truth.
examples.zh: 她是個正直的人，總是說實話。

examples.en: The little boy stood upright for the photo.
examples.zh: 小男孩為了拍照而站得筆直。

examples.en: Keep the bottle upright so the juice won't spill.
examples.zh: 把瓶子直立放好，果汁才不會灑出來。

examples.en: She sat upright and began to speak.
examples.zh: 她挺直身子坐好，開始說話。

examples.en: The students read about the uprising in their history class.
examples.zh: 學生們在歷史課上讀到了那場起義。

examples.en: The uprising in the city lasted for several weeks.
examples.zh: 城裡的起義持續了好幾個星期。

examples.en: The film tells the story of an uprising against the king.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述了一場反抗國王的起義。

examples.en: The doctor spoke with great urgency on the phone.
examples.zh: 醫生在電話中語氣十分急迫。

examples.en: There is no urgency, so take your time.
examples.zh: 這件事不急，慢慢來。

examples.en: The urgency of the situation was clear to everyone.
examples.zh: 情況的緊急程度，大家都看得很清楚。

examples.en: The usher showed us to our seats in the theater.
examples.zh: 帶位員帶我們到劇院裡的座位。

examples.en: She works as an usher at the concert hall.
examples.zh: 她在音樂廳擔任帶位員。

examples.en: An usher handed each guest a program.
examples.zh: 一位招待員發給每位賓客一份節目單。

examples.en: A waiter ushered us to a table by the window.
examples.zh: 服務生帶我們到靠窗的桌位。

examples.en: The secretary ushered the visitors into the meeting room.
examples.zh: 秘書把訪客帶進會議室。

examples.en: The new law will usher in many changes.
examples.zh: 這項新法將帶來許多改變。

examples.en: A fork is an eating utensil found on most dinner tables.
examples.zh: 叉子是一種在大多數餐桌上都能見到的餐具。

examples.en: Mom keeps all the kitchen utensils in the drawer.
examples.zh: 媽媽把所有廚房用具都放在抽屜裡。

examples.en: Please wash the utensils after dinner and put them away.
examples.zh: 晚餐後請把餐具洗乾淨並收好。

examples.en: The baby uttered a happy cry when his mother appeared.
examples.zh: 寶寶看到媽媽出現時，發出了開心的叫聲。

examples.en: He did not utter a word during the whole meeting.
examples.zh: 整場會議他一句話也沒說。

examples.en: She was so shocked that she could hardly utter a sound.
examples.zh: 她驚訝得幾乎發不出聲音。

examples.en: The test was an utter disaster for me.
examples.zh: 那場考試對我來說簡直是一場大災難。

examples.en: We stood in utter silence after the announcement.
examples.zh: 公告之後，我們在一片寂靜中站著。

examples.en: He looked at me in utter surprise.
examples.zh: 他一臉十足驚訝地看著我。

examples.en: The nurse gave my little sister a flu vaccine.
examples.zh: 護理師幫我妹妹打了流感疫苗。

examples.en: Scientists worked hard to develop a new vaccine.
examples.zh: 科學家們努力研發一種新疫苗。

examples.en: You need this vaccine before you travel to some countries.
examples.zh: 去某些國家旅行前需要先接種這種疫苗。

examples.en: Add a spoonful of vanilla to the cake mix.
examples.zh: 在蛋糕麵糊裡加一匙香草精。

examples.en: I'd like a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
examples.zh: 我想要一球香草冰淇淋。

examples.en: The kitchen smelled sweet like vanilla after she finished baking.
examples.zh: 她烘焙完後，廚房裡聞起來有香草般的甜香。

examples.en: She ordered a vanilla milkshake at the cafe.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡廳點了一杯香草奶昔。

examples.en: We bought a vanilla cake for Dad's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們買了一個香草蛋糕給爸爸慶生。

examples.en: This is just a vanilla phone with no special features.
examples.zh: 這只是一支沒有特殊功能的普通手機。

examples.en: His vanity makes it hard for him to accept advice.
examples.zh: 他的虛榮心讓他很難接受別人的建議。

examples.en: She spent hours in front of the mirror out of vanity.
examples.zh: 出於虛榮心，她在鏡子前花了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Vanity is often the cause of foolish choices.
examples.zh: 虛榮常常是愚蠢決定的原因。

examples.en: The bride wore a long white veil.
examples.zh: 新娘戴著一條長長的白色面紗。

examples.en: A veil of mist covered the valley.
examples.zh: 一層薄霧籠罩著山谷。

examples.en: The details of the plan were hidden behind a veil of secrecy.
examples.zh: 這個計畫的細節被籠罩在秘密之中。

examples.en: Clouds veiled the mountain top this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上雲霧遮住了山頂。

examples.en: She veiled her face with a scarf.
examples.zh: 她用圍巾遮住了臉。

examples.en: He tried to veil his anger with a smile.
examples.zh: 他試著用微笑掩飾自己的怒氣。

examples.en: The curtains in the theater are made of red velvet.
examples.zh: 劇院的窗簾是用紅色天鵝絨做的。

examples.en: She wore a black velvet dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件黑色絲絨洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: The box was lined with soft velvet.
examples.zh: 盒子內裡鋪著柔軟的絲絨。

examples.en: This versatile jacket works for both rain and cold weather.
examples.zh: 這件多用途的外套下雨和寒冷的天氣都能穿。

examples.en: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
examples.zh: 他是個多才多藝的球員，可以擔任多個位置。

examples.en: Rice is a versatile food that goes with many dishes.
examples.zh: 米飯是一種用途廣泛的食物，和很多菜都很搭。

examples.en: The veterinarian checked our dog's ears because he kept scratching them.
examples.zh: 因為我們家的狗一直搔耳朵，獸醫便檢查了牠的耳朵。

examples.en: My cousin wants to become a veterinarian.
examples.zh: 我表哥想成為獸醫。

examples.en: We took the sick cat to the veterinarian yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天帶生病的貓去看獸醫。

examples.en: The president used his veto to stop the bill.
examples.zh: 總統行使否決權，阻止了這項法案。

examples.en: The class leader has no power of veto.
examples.zh: 班長沒有否決的權力。

examples.en: A veto from the manager ended the discussion.
examples.zh: 經理的否決結束了討論。

examples.en: The parents vetoed the idea of a late night trip.
examples.zh: 家長們否決了深夜出遊的點子。

examples.en: The mayor vetoed the plan to close the park.
examples.zh: 市長否決了關閉公園的計畫。

examples.en: My boss vetoed the new design because it was too expensive.
examples.zh: 我的老闆因為成本太高而否決了新的設計。

examples.en: My phone will vibrate when a new message arrives.
examples.zh: 有新訊息時，我的手機會震動。

examples.en: The windows vibrate whenever a truck passes the house.
examples.zh: 每當卡車經過房子，窗戶就會震動。

examples.en: A guitar string vibrates when you pluck it.
examples.zh: 你撥弦時，吉他的弦會振動。

examples.en: The vibration of the train made the cups rattle.
examples.zh: 火車的震動讓杯子嘎嘎作響。

examples.en: Please turn on the vibration mode during the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會時請開啟震動模式。

examples.en: Scientists measure the vibration of the ground after an earthquake.
examples.zh: 科學家測量地震後地面的震動。

examples.en: Staying up too late is a vice of mine.
examples.zh: 熬夜到很晚是我的一個壞習慣。

examples.en: Eating too much sugar is a common vice among teenagers.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖是青少年常見的壞習慣。

examples.en: Honesty is a virtue, and lying is a vice.
examples.zh: 誠實是美德，說謊則是惡習。

examples.en: The victor of the speech contest received a gold medal.
examples.zh: 演講比賽的優勝者獲得了一面金牌。

examples.en: Our class became the victor of the school relay race.
examples.zh: 我們班成為校內接力賽的勝利者。

examples.en: The victor thanked her teacher and her family.
examples.zh: 優勝者感謝了她的老師和家人。

examples.en: Our family rented a villa near the beach for the summer.
examples.zh: 我們家在夏天租了一棟靠近海灘的別墅。

examples.en: The villa has a large garden and a swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這棟別墅有一個大花園和一座游泳池。

examples.en: They bought an old villa in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他們在鄉下買了一棟老別墅。

examples.en: The villain in the movie tried to steal the treasure.
examples.zh: 電影裡的反派想偷走那份寶藏。

examples.en: Children often cheer when the villain loses.
examples.zh: 反派輸了的時候，孩子們常常歡呼。

examples.en: The actor is famous for playing the villain in cartoons.
examples.zh: 這位演員因為在卡通裡配反派角色而出名。

examples.en: A green vine grew up the wall of our house.
examples.zh: 一條綠色的藤蔓沿著我們家的牆往上爬。

examples.en: Grapes grow on a vine in the sunny valley.
examples.zh: 葡萄長在向陽山谷裡的葡萄藤上。

examples.en: The farmer cut the dead vine in early spring.
examples.zh: 農夫在早春剪掉了枯死的藤蔓。

examples.en: We walked through the vineyard on a sunny afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們在一個晴朗的下午穿過葡萄園散步。

examples.en: The family owns a small vineyard in France.
examples.zh: 這家人在法國擁有一座小葡萄園。

examples.en: Tourists can pick grapes at the vineyard in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天時，遊客可以在葡萄園裡採葡萄。

examples.en: The kids ran around with great vitality.
examples.zh: 孩子們充滿活力地到處跑。

examples.en: Regular exercise gives older people more vitality.
examples.zh: 規律運動能讓年長者更有活力。

examples.en: The new shops brought vitality back to the old street.
examples.zh: 新開的商店讓老街重新有了活力。

examples.en: Teaching is not just a job but a vocation for her.
examples.zh: 教書對她來說不只是工作，而是天職。

examples.en: He felt that nursing was his true vocation.
examples.zh: 他覺得當護理師才是自己真正的使命。

examples.en: Many students choose a vocation after they finish school.
examples.zh: 許多學生在完成學業後選擇一項職業。

examples.en: My brother attends a vocational high school.
examples.zh: 我哥哥就讀高職。

examples.en: The school offers vocational training in cooking and design.
examples.zh: 這所學校提供烹飪與設計的職業訓練。

examples.en: Vocational courses help students find jobs more easily.
examples.zh: 職業課程能幫助學生更容易找到工作。

examples.en: The puppy began to wag its tail when it saw me.
examples.zh: 小狗一看到我就開始搖尾巴。

examples.en: Cats sometimes wag their tails when they feel annoyed.
examples.zh: 貓有時會在感到煩躁時甩尾巴。

examples.en: The teacher wagged her finger and told us to be quiet.
examples.zh: 老師搖著手指，叫我們安靜。

examples.en: My grandmother puts a walnut in every cookie she bakes.
examples.zh: 我奶奶烤的每一片餅乾裡都放了一顆核桃。

examples.en: Walnuts are good for your brain, according to some doctors.
examples.zh: 根據一些醫師的說法，核桃對大腦有益。

examples.en: The table is made of dark walnut wood.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是用深色的胡桃木做的。

examples.en: I hung my coat in the wardrobe in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 我把外套掛進臥室的衣櫃裡。

examples.en: The wardrobe is too small for all our clothes.
examples.zh: 這個衣櫃太小，放不下我們所有的衣服。

examples.en: She bought a few new shirts to update her wardrobe.
examples.zh: 她買了幾件新襯衫來更新自己的衣物。

senses.zh: 搜索令；逮捕令；正當理由

examples.en: The police needed a warrant to search the building.
examples.zh: 警方需要搜索令才能搜查這棟建築。

examples.en: The judge signed a warrant for the man's arrest.
examples.zh: 法官簽發了逮捕那名男子的令狀。

examples.en: There is no warrant for such a rude reply.
examples.zh: 如此無禮的回答沒有正當理由。

examples.en: This problem warrants more attention from the school.
examples.zh: 這個問題值得學校多加關注。

examples.en: The long delay warrants an apology from the airline.
examples.zh: 這麼久的延誤，航空公司理當道歉。

examples.en: Nothing in his report warrants such a harsh reaction.
examples.zh: 他的報告內容不足以構成做出如此強烈反應的理由。

examples.en: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
examples.zh: 這台筆記型電腦附有兩年保固。

examples.en: The warranty has expired, so we must pay for the repair.
examples.zh: 保固已經過期，所以我們得自己付維修費。

examples.en: Please keep your receipt and warranty card in a safe place.
examples.zh: 請把收據和保證書收在安全的地方。

examples.en: The weary travelers fell asleep on the bus.
examples.zh: 疲倦的旅客們在公車上睡著了。

examples.en: She gave her mother a weary smile after a long day.
examples.zh: 漫長的一天後，她對媽媽露出疲倦的微笑。

examples.en: I am weary of eating the same lunch every week.
examples.zh: 我已經吃膩了每週都一樣的午餐。

examples.en: Long meetings weary everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 冗長的會議讓辦公室裡的每個人都感到疲倦。

examples.en: The heavy traffic began to weary the driver.
examples.zh: 壅塞的車流開始讓司機疲倦。

examples.en: He did not want to weary his guests with a long speech.
examples.zh: 他不想用冗長的演說讓客人厭煩。

examples.en: The fishing boats were tied up at the wharf.
examples.zh: 漁船都繫在碼頭邊。

examples.en: We walked along the wharf and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 我們沿著碼頭散步，欣賞日落。

examples.en: Workers unloaded boxes from the ship onto the wharf.
examples.zh: 工人把箱子從船上卸到碼頭上。

examples.en: My uncle poured a glass of whiskey after dinner.
examples.zh: 我叔叔晚餐後倒了一杯威士忌。

examples.en: This whiskey was kept in wooden barrels for ten years.
examples.zh: 這款威士忌在木桶裡放了十年。

examples.en: The shop sells whiskey from Ireland and Scotland.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自愛爾蘭和蘇格蘭的威士忌。

examples.en: The shop buys fruit at wholesale and sells it at a profit.
examples.zh: 這家店以批發價買水果，再賺取利潤賣出。

examples.en: Wholesale is cheaper than buying from a regular store.
examples.zh: 批發比向一般商店購買便宜。

examples.en: He works in wholesale and supplies many small restaurants.
examples.zh: 他從事批發業，供貨給許多小餐廳。

examples.en: We found a wholesale market with very low prices.
examples.zh: 我們找到一個價格很低的批發市場。

examples.en: The wholesale price of rice has gone up this year.
examples.zh: 今年米的批發價格上漲了。

examples.en: The company made wholesale changes to its schedule.
examples.zh: 公司對時程表做了大幅度的更動。

examples.en: My mother cooks wholesome meals for the whole family.
examples.zh: 我媽媽為全家人煮有益健康的餐點。

examples.en: This is a wholesome movie that children can watch.
examples.zh: 這是一部內容健康、適合孩子觀看的電影。

examples.en: Playing outdoors is a wholesome way to spend the weekend.
examples.zh: 到戶外玩是度過週末的健康方式。

examples.en: The widow lives alone in a small house near the park.
examples.zh: 那位寡婦獨自住在公園附近的一間小房子裡。

examples.en: Neighbors often bring food to the elderly widow.
examples.zh: 鄰居常常送食物給那位年長的寡婦。

examples.en: She became a widow at the age of forty.
examples.zh: 她四十歲時成為寡婦。

examples.en: The company may withhold part of your pay for taxes.
examples.zh: 公司可能會預扣你的一部分薪水作為稅款。

examples.en: Please do not withhold any information from your teacher.
examples.zh: 請不要對老師隱瞞任何資訊。

examples.en: The bank decided to withhold the payment until the form arrived.
examples.zh: 銀行決定在表格送達之前先不支付款項。

examples.en: He told his friends about his money woes.
examples.zh: 他向朋友訴說自己的經濟困境。

examples.en: Her face was full of woe after she received the sad news.
examples.zh: 收到那個令人難過的消息後，她滿臉悲傷。

examples.en: Traffic woes make life hard for people in the city.
examples.zh: 交通問題讓城市居民的生活很辛苦。

examples.en: A woodpecker was knocking on the tree outside my window.
examples.zh: 一隻啄木鳥在我窗外的樹上啄個不停。

examples.en: The woodpecker uses its long beak to find insects.
examples.zh: 啄木鳥用長長的鳥喙尋找昆蟲。

examples.en: We heard a woodpecker while hiking in the forest.
examples.zh: 我們在森林健行時聽到了啄木鳥的聲音。

examples.en: The company has a workforce of about two hundred people.
examples.zh: 這家公司大約有兩百名員工。

examples.en: More women have joined the workforce in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來有更多女性加入勞動市場。

examples.en: A young workforce can bring new ideas to a business.
examples.zh: 年輕的勞動力能為企業帶來新點子。

senses.zh: 摔角；奮力搬動；努力解決

examples.en: The two brothers like to wrestle on the carpet.
examples.zh: 這兩兄弟喜歡在地毯上摔角。

examples.en: I wrestled with the heavy suitcase all the way up the stairs.
examples.zh: 我吃力地拖著沉重的行李箱爬上樓梯。

examples.en: The students wrestled with a hard math problem for an hour.
examples.zh: 學生們為了一道很難的數學題苦思了一個小時。

examples.en: She yearns for a quiet life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她渴望過鄉下寧靜的生活。

examples.en: The boy yearned to see his father again.
examples.zh: 那個男孩渴望再見到父親一面。

examples.en: Many students yearn for a long summer vacation.
examples.zh: 許多學生都渴望一個長長的暑假。

examples.en: I do yoga every morning to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 我每天早上做瑜伽來保持健康。

examples.en: The community center offers a free yoga class on Sundays.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心週日開設免費的瑜伽課。

examples.en: Yoga helped my father relax his back and shoulders.
examples.zh: 瑜伽幫助我爸爸放鬆了背部與肩膀。

examples.en: Motorcycles zoom past the school gate every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上都有機車呼嘯駛過校門口。

examples.en: Please zoom in on the map to see the street names.
examples.zh: 請放大地圖，看看街道名稱。

examples.en: The camera zoomed in on the singer's face.
examples.zh: 攝影機把畫面拉近到歌手的臉上。

examples.en: The zoom of the engine woke up the whole street.
examples.zh: 引擎的嗡嗡聲吵醒了整條街的人。

examples.en: This camera has a powerful zoom for taking photos of birds.
examples.zh: 這台相機有強大的變焦功能，可以拍鳥。

examples.en: We heard the zoom of a racing car on TV.
examples.zh: 我們在電視上聽到賽車的呼嘯聲。

examples.en: Please align the edges of the paper before you cut it.
examples.zh: 剪紙之前，請先把紙的邊緣對齊。

examples.en: The company wants to align its plans with customer needs.
examples.zh: 公司希望讓計畫與客戶需求一致。

examples.en: Several countries aligned themselves with the new agreement.
examples.zh: 幾個國家支持這項新協議。

examples.en: This bicycle frame is made of aluminum.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是用鋁做的。

examples.en: Please put the used aluminum cans in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把用過的鋁罐丟進回收箱。

examples.en: Aluminum is light and does not rust easily.
examples.zh: 鋁很輕，也不容易生鏽。

examples.en: She aspires to become a doctor one day.
examples.zh: 她立志有一天成為醫師。

examples.en: Many young people aspire to start their own business.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人渴望創辦自己的事業。

examples.en: He aspired to play for the national team.
examples.zh: 他渴望加入國家代表隊。

examples.en: The little girl has long blond hair.
examples.zh: 那個小女孩有一頭金色的長髮。

examples.en: My cousin dyed his hair blond last summer.
examples.zh: 我表哥去年夏天把頭髮染成了金色。

examples.en: The actor is tall, blond and very friendly.
examples.zh: 那位演員高高的、金髮，而且很和善。

examples.en: The blond in the red jacket is my classmate.
examples.zh: 穿紅外套的那個金髮男生是我同學。

examples.en: A tall blond walked into the cafe and sat down.
examples.zh: 一個高高的金髮男子走進咖啡廳坐了下來。

examples.en: The teacher asked the blond to move to the front row.
examples.zh: 老師請那個金髮男生移到前排。

examples.en: My brother started boxing to keep fit.
examples.zh: 我弟弟為了保持健康開始練拳擊。

examples.en: Boxing requires strong legs and good balance.
examples.zh: 拳擊需要強壯的雙腿和良好的平衡感。

examples.en: We watched a boxing match on TV last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在電視上看了一場拳擊比賽。

examples.en: Scientists study cellular changes in the human body.
examples.zh: 科學家研究人體內的細胞變化。

examples.en: A cellular network lets people make calls from almost anywhere.
examples.zh: 行動通訊網路讓人幾乎在任何地方都能打電話。

examples.en: The cellular structure of a leaf can be seen under a microscope.
examples.zh: 在顯微鏡下可以看到葉子的細胞結構。

examples.en: The chairwoman opened the meeting at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 女主席在九點時宣布開會。

examples.en: Our chairwoman thanked the employees for their hard work.
examples.zh: 我們的女董事長感謝員工們的辛勤付出。

examples.en: She was elected chairwoman of the student club.
examples.zh: 她被選為學生社團的主席。

examples.en: Add a little chili to the soup if you like it spicy.
examples.zh: 如果你喜歡吃辣，可以在湯裡加一點辣椒。

examples.en: My grandfather grows chili in his small garden.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在他的小花園裡種辣椒。

examples.en: The chili sauce was too hot for the children.
examples.zh: 這個辣椒醬對孩子們來說太辣了。

examples.en: There is a cold draught coming from under the door.
examples.zh: 門縫底下吹進來一陣冷風。

examples.en: Please close the window to stop the draught.
examples.zh: 請把窗戶關上，擋住穿堂風。

examples.en: He drank the glass in one long draught.
examples.zh: 他一口氣把那杯飲料喝完。

examples.en: The new rule will equalize the chances for all students.
examples.zh: 這項新規定將使所有學生的機會均等。

examples.en: The team scored late in the game to equalize.
examples.zh: 球隊在比賽後段進球扳平了比分。

examples.en: We need to equalize the weight on both sides of the scale.
examples.zh: 我們需要讓天平兩邊的重量相等。

examples.en: She loves the glamour of the movie industry.
examples.zh: 她著迷於電影圈的魅力。

examples.en: The party was full of glamour and bright lights.
examples.zh: 這場派對充滿魅力與璀璨的燈光。

examples.en: Her job is not as full of glamour as people think.
examples.zh: 她的工作沒有大家想的那麼光鮮亮麗。

examples.en: I lost my left headphone on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把左邊的耳機弄丟在公車上了。

examples.en: He wore a headphone while studying in the library.
examples.zh: 他在圖書館念書時戴著一邊耳機。

examples.en: These headphones have a cable that cannot reach my computer.
examples.zh: 這副耳機的線不夠長，接不到我的電腦。

examples.en: He is invariably late for the first class.
examples.zh: 他第一堂課總是遲到。

examples.en: The bus is invariably full on Monday mornings.
examples.zh: 週一早上公車總是客滿。

examples.en: Winter in this city is invariably cold and wet.
examples.zh: 這座城市的冬天總是又濕又冷。

examples.en: Our jolly neighbor always says hello with a big smile.
examples.zh: 我們快樂的鄰居總是笑容滿面地打招呼。

examples.en: The jolly music made everyone dance at the party.
examples.zh: 歡樂的音樂讓派對上的每個人都跳起舞來。

examples.en: Grandpa was in a jolly mood after the family dinner.
examples.zh: 家人聚餐後，爺爺心情很愉快。

examples.en: The box was full of miscellaneous items from the garage.
examples.zh: 那個箱子裡裝滿了車庫裡的各種雜物。

examples.en: I spent some money on miscellaneous expenses.
examples.zh: 我在雜項開銷上花了一些錢。

examples.en: Put miscellaneous papers in the blue folder.
examples.zh: 請把各式各樣的文件放進藍色資料夾。

senses.zh: 第十四個英文字母；（數學中的）任意數或未知數

examples.en: The word noon begins with the letter n.
examples.zh: noon 這個字是以字母 n 開頭。

examples.en: In this equation, n stands for any whole number.
examples.zh: 在這個方程式中，n 代表任意非負整數。

examples.en: Please write a small n on the line below.
examples.zh: 請在下面那條線上寫一個小寫的 n。

examples.en: She started psychotherapy to deal with her stress.
examples.zh: 她開始接受心理治療來面對壓力。

examples.en: Psychotherapy can help people talk about their feelings.
examples.zh: 心理治療可以幫助人們談論自己的感受。

examples.en: The hospital offers psychotherapy for teenagers struggling with anxiety.
examples.zh: 這家醫院為受焦慮困擾的青少年提供心理治療。

examples.en: Many small towns are reliant on tourism.
examples.zh: 許多小鎮都仰賴觀光業。

examples.en: The baby is reliant on his mother for food.
examples.zh: 嬰兒要靠媽媽提供食物。

examples.en: We should not be too reliant on our phones.
examples.zh: 我們不該過度依賴手機。

examples.en: The restoration of the old temple took three years.
examples.zh: 那座古廟的修復花了三年時間。

examples.en: The city is planning the restoration of the old train station.
examples.zh: 市政府正計畫修復舊火車站。

examples.en: We are waiting for the restoration of power after the storm.
examples.zh: 我們正在等待暴風雨後恢復供電。

examples.en: My shortsighted brother cannot read the board without glasses.
examples.zh: 我近視的弟弟沒戴眼鏡就看不清黑板。

examples.en: It would be shortsighted to ignore the cost of repairs.
examples.zh: 忽略維修的費用是很短視的。

examples.en: The shortsighted plan caused problems for the company later.
examples.zh: 這個短視的計畫後來給公司帶來了問題。

examples.en: The company's spokeswoman said the store would reopen on Monday.
examples.zh: 公司的女發言人表示，這家店星期一會重新開張。

examples.en: A spokeswoman for the school answered questions from parents.
examples.zh: 學校的一位女發言人回答了家長的提問。

examples.en: The spokeswoman will speak to the reporters at noon.
examples.zh: 這位女發言人中午會對記者說明。

examples.en: The statute requires every driver to carry a valid license.
examples.zh: 這項法規要求每位駕駛人隨身攜帶有效的駕照。

examples.en: Under this statute, companies must report their yearly income.
examples.zh: 依照這項條例，公司必須申報年度收入。

examples.en: The city passed a new statute about noise at night.
examples.zh: 市政府通過了一項關於夜間噪音的新條例。

examples.en: Please write your surname in the first box of the form.
examples.zh: 請把你的姓氏寫在表格的第一格。

examples.en: Her surname is Chen, but her friends call her Amy.
examples.zh: 她姓陳，但朋友都叫她艾咪。

examples.en: In Taiwan, the surname usually comes before the given name.
examples.zh: 在台灣，姓氏通常放在名字前面。

examples.en: My uncle works in telecommunications and repairs phone networks.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在電信業工作，負責維修電話網路。

examples.en: Telecommunications have changed the way people keep in touch.
examples.zh: 電信的發展改變了人們保持聯絡的方式。

examples.en: The telecommunications company is offering a new plan for students.
examples.zh: 這家電信公司推出了針對學生的新方案。

examples.en: Several airlines offer cheap tickets to Tokyo in spring.
examples.zh: 有幾家航空公司在春天提供飛往東京的便宜機票。

examples.en: Most airlines let passengers bring one small bag on board.
examples.zh: 大多數航空公司都允許乘客帶一個小包包登機。

examples.en: The airlines announced that all flights would leave late.
examples.zh: 各家航空公司宣布所有班機都會延後起飛。

examples.en: She ate an apple after lunch before returning to class.
examples.zh: 她午餐後吃了一顆蘋果，才回去上課。

examples.en: I waited for an hour outside the library.
examples.zh: 我在圖書館外面等了一個小時。

examples.en: He is an honest student who always tells the truth.
examples.zh: 他是個誠實的學生，總是說實話。

examples.en: I ordered a chicken burger and a small salad.
examples.zh: 我點了一個雞肉漢堡和一份小沙拉。

examples.en: The burger came with fries and a cold drink.
examples.zh: 這個漢堡附有薯條和一杯冷飲。

examples.en: Dad cooked a burger for each of us on Sunday.
examples.zh: 星期天爸爸為我們每人煎了一塊漢堡肉。

examples.en: Can you use chopsticks to pick up these small peanuts?
examples.zh: 你能用筷子夾起這些小花生嗎？

examples.en: Please put the chopsticks next to each bowl.
examples.zh: 請把筷子放在每個碗旁邊。

examples.en: The waiter gave us a pair of wooden chopsticks.
examples.zh: 服務生給了我們一雙木筷。

senses.zh: 做；用於過去式問句或否定句

examples.en: She did her homework before dinner so she could relax afterward.
examples.zh: 她在晚餐前做完了功課，好讓自己之後能放鬆。

examples.en: We did the dishes together after the meal.
examples.zh: 飯後我們一起洗了碗。

examples.en: Did your class finish the survey about school lunches?
examples.zh: 你們班完成關於學校午餐的調查了嗎？

examples.en: I sent an e-mail to my teacher about the homework.
examples.zh: 我寄了一封電子郵件給老師詢問作業。

examples.en: Please check your e-mail for the meeting time.
examples.zh: 請查看你的電子郵件，確認開會時間。

examples.en: She received an e-mail from the hotel this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上收到了旅館寄來的電子郵件。

senses.zh: 寄電子郵件給；以電子郵件傳送

examples.en: Please e-mail me the report by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前用電子郵件把報告寄給我。

examples.en: He will e-mail the photos to his grandparents tonight.
examples.zh: 他今晚會把照片用電子郵件寄給祖父母。

examples.en: You can e-mail us if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如果你有任何問題，可以寄電子郵件給我們。

examples.en: She wore silver earrings to her cousin's wedding.
examples.zh: 她戴著銀色耳環去參加表姊的婚禮。

examples.en: I lost one of my earrings on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上弄丟了一只耳環。

examples.en: These earrings would make a nice gift for your mother.
examples.zh: 這對耳環很適合當作送給你媽媽的禮物。

examples.en: Our hard-working neighbor repairs bikes every weekend.
examples.zh: 我們勤勞的鄰居每個週末都修理腳踏車。

examples.en: The teacher praised the hard-working students in the class.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚班上努力用功的學生。

examples.en: She is a hard-working nurse who rarely takes a day off.
examples.zh: 她是一位認真工作的護理師，很少請假。

examples.en: The hippo spent the whole afternoon in the water.
examples.zh: 那隻河馬整個下午都待在水裡。

examples.en: Children laughed when the hippo opened its huge mouth.
examples.zh: 那隻河馬張開大嘴時，孩子們都笑了。

examples.en: We saw a baby hippo at the zoo yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在動物園看到了一隻小河馬。

examples.en: It is impolite to talk with food in your mouth.
examples.zh: 嘴裡有食物時說話是不禮貌的。

examples.en: He felt that her answer was rather impolite.
examples.zh: 他覺得她的回答相當無禮。

examples.en: Looking at your phone during a meeting can seem impolite.
examples.zh: 開會時看手機可能會顯得不禮貌。

examples.en: It is impossible to finish this project in one day.
examples.zh: 要在一天內完成這個專案是不可能的。

examples.en: The heavy rain made the road almost impossible to drive on.
examples.zh: 大雨讓這條路幾乎無法行駛。

examples.en: She thought the math problem was impossible at first.
examples.zh: 她起初覺得這道數學題根本做不出來。

examples.en: The mailman brings letters to our house every morning.
examples.zh: 郵差每天早上都會把信送到我們家。

examples.en: Our mailman always greets us with a friendly smile.
examples.zh: 我們的郵差總是笑容親切地向我們打招呼。

examples.en: The mailman left a package at the front door.
examples.zh: 郵差把一個包裹放在前門。

examples.en: The doctor said my dog was a little over-weight.
examples.zh: 醫生說我的狗有點過重。

examples.en: Your suitcase is over-weight, so you must pay an extra fee.
examples.zh: 你的行李箱超重了，所以必須多付一筆費用。

examples.en: He felt tired because he was over-weight and never exercised.
examples.zh: 他覺得很疲累，因為他體重過重又從不運動。

examples.en: A new railway will connect the two cities next year.
examples.zh: 明年將有一條新的鐵路連接這兩座城市。

examples.en: We walked across the bridge over the railway.
examples.zh: 我們走過鐵道上方的那座橋。

examples.en: My grandfather worked for the railway for thirty years.
examples.zh: 我祖父在鐵路公司工作了三十年。

examples.en: In the old story, a giant roc carried the sailor away.
examples.zh: 在古老的故事裡，一隻巨大的大鵬鳥把水手帶走了。

examples.en: The children drew a roc with huge wings for the art class.
examples.zh: 孩子們在美術課畫了一隻長著巨大翅膀的大鵬鳥。

examples.en: The roc in this book is said to lift an elephant.
examples.zh: 這本書裡的大鵬鳥據說能抓起一頭大象。

examples.en: The salesman showed us three different laptops.
examples.zh: 那位業務員向我們展示了三台不同的筆記型電腦。

examples.en: My father works as a car salesman in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我父親在台中擔任汽車業務員。

examples.en: The salesman gave us a discount on the sofa.
examples.zh: 業務員給了我們沙發的折扣。

examples.en: Please take off your shoes and put on these slippers.
examples.zh: 請脫掉鞋子，換上這雙拖鞋。

examples.en: My cat likes to sleep next to my slippers.
examples.zh: 我的貓喜歡睡在我的拖鞋旁邊。

examples.en: She bought a pair of warm slippers for the winter.
examples.zh: 她為冬天買了一雙保暖的拖鞋。

examples.en: I wear sneakers to school on PE days.
examples.zh: 體育課那天我穿球鞋去學校。

examples.en: These white sneakers are comfortable for long walks.
examples.zh: 這雙白色球鞋很適合長時間散步。

examples.en: He saved his allowance to buy a new pair of sneakers.
examples.zh: 他存零用錢想買一雙新球鞋。

examples.en: I can't find my other socks anywhere.
examples.zh: 我到處都找不到其他襪子。

examples.en: Mom bought me three pairs of warm socks.
examples.zh: 媽媽買了三雙保暖的襪子給我。

examples.en: Please put your dirty socks in the laundry basket.
examples.zh: 請把你的髒襪子放進洗衣籃。

examples.en: Add a little soy-sauce to the soup before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前在湯裡加一點醬油。

examples.en: My grandmother makes braised pork with soy-sauce and sugar.
examples.zh: 我奶奶用醬油和糖滷肉。

examples.en: Do you want soy-sauce for your dumplings?
examples.zh: 你的水餃要沾醬油嗎？

examples.en: Basketball is one of the most popular sports at our school.
examples.zh: 籃球是我們學校最受歡迎的運動之一。

examples.en: Do you play any sports after class?
examples.zh: 你下課後會從事任何運動嗎？

examples.en: The sports day will be held on the school playground.
examples.zh: 運動會將在學校操場舉行。

examples.en: Be careful when you walk down the stairs.
examples.zh: 走下樓梯時要小心。

examples.en: The elevator is broken, so we took the stairs.
examples.zh: 電梯壞了，所以我們走樓梯。

examples.en: Our classroom is at the top of the stairs.
examples.zh: 我們的教室在樓梯的最上面。

examples.en: She looked unhappy when she heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 她聽到壞消息時看起來很不開心。

examples.en: Many customers were unhappy with the long waiting time.
examples.zh: 許多顧客對等候時間太長感到不滿。

examples.en: He felt unhappy about moving to a new school.
examples.zh: 他對轉到新學校感到難過。

examples.en: My brother was a good swimmer when he was young.
examples.zh: 我哥哥年輕時是個游泳高手。

examples.en: There was a funny scene in the movie that made us laugh.
examples.zh: 電影裡有一個好笑的片段，讓我們笑了出來。

examples.en: I was at the library until six o'clock.
examples.zh: 我在圖書館待到六點。

examples.en: We hiked to see two beautiful waterfalls in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們健行到山上看了兩座美麗的瀑布。

examples.en: Waterfalls are especially powerful after a lot of rain.
examples.zh: 下過大雨之後，瀑布的水勢特別強勁。

examples.en: The park has several small waterfalls near the trail.
examples.zh: 這座公園的步道附近有好幾處小瀑布。

examples.en: We were very tired after the long trip.
examples.zh: 長途旅行後，我們都很累。

examples.en: The students were in the gym during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，學生們都在體育館裡。

examples.en: There were many people at the night market.
examples.zh: 夜市裡有很多人。

examples.en: We took a walk in the woods behind our school.
examples.zh: 我們在學校後面的樹林裡散步。

examples.en: The children found a small stream in the woods.
examples.zh: 孩子們在樹林裡發現了一條小溪。

examples.en: Many birds live in the woods near our town.
examples.zh: 我們鎮附近的樹林裡住著許多鳥。
